title.zh: 卷233 列傳二十 图尔格 伊尔登 巴奇兰 齐尔格申 葉臣 珠玛喇
title.en: Volume 233 Biographies 20: Tu Er Ge, Yi Erdeng, Ba Qilan, Qi Ergeshen, Ye Chen, Zhu Ma La
title.raw: 卷233 列傳二十 图尔格 伊尔登 巴奇兰 齐尔格申 葉臣 珠玛喇

sentences.zh: 圖爾格，滿洲鑲白旗人，額亦都第八子也。

translations.literal: Tu Erge—Tu Erge was a man of the Manchu Bordered White Banner, the eighth son of Eyi'du.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Erge was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner and the eighth son of Eyi'du.

sentences.zh: 少從太祖征伐，積功授世職參將。

translations.literal: In his youth he followed the Taizu on campaigns; for accumulated merit he was granted the hereditary office of colonel.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he followed Taizu on campaign, and for accumulated merit received a hereditary colonel's rank.

sentences.zh: 尚和碩公主。

translations.literal: He married a princess of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: He married an imperial princess of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，八旗各設大臣二，備調遣，亦號「十六大臣」，以圖爾格佐鑲白旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, two ministers were appointed in each of the Eight Banners to stand ready for dispatch, also called the "Sixteen Ministers"; Tu Erge was assigned to assist the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, each banner received two ministers ready for dispatch—the "Sixteen Ministers"—and Tu Erge was assigned to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 尋遷本旗固山額真，列八大臣。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to gushan ejen of his own banner and ranked among the Eight Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made gushan ejen of his banner and counted among the Eight Ministers.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，上伐明，圖爾格率所部從攻錦州，不克，隳大小凌河二城而還。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong, the emperor attacked Ming; Tu Erge led his division in the assault on Jinzhou, could not take it, demolished the two cities of Greater and Lesser Linghe, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1, when the emperor campaigned against Ming, Tu Erge led his troops in the attack on Jinzhou. The city did not fall; they razed the cities at Greater and Lesser Linghe and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二年，追錄其父額亦都功，進世職總兵官。

translations.literal: In the second year, in recognition of his father Eyi'du's achievements, he was promoted in hereditary office to commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year his father's service was commemorated, and he was promoted in hereditary rank to commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，從伐明，克遵化。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against Ming and took Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Ming and helped capture Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 四年，上還師，命貝勒阿敏護諸將屯永平，而圖爾格與正黃旗固山額真納穆泰，正紅旗調遣大臣湯古岱，榜式庫爾纏、高鴻中守灤州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the emperor withdrew the army and ordered Prince Amin to escort the generals to garrison Yongping, while Tu Erge, Namutai the gushan ejen of the Plain Yellow Banner, Tang Gudai the dispatch minister of the Plain Red Banner, and the secretaries Ku'erchan and Gao Hongzhong were to hold Luanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, as the emperor withdrew, Prince Amin was ordered to escort the generals to garrison Yongping, while Tu Erge, Namutai of the Plain Yellow Banner, Tang Gudai of the Plain Red Banner, and secretaries Ku'erchan and Gao Hongzhong were left to hold Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 明監軍道張春，總兵官祖大壽、馬世龍、楊紹基等，合軍來攻，圖爾格與納穆泰、湯古岱分地設汛以守。

translations.literal: Ming supervising censor Zhang Chun, commanders-in-chief Zu Dashou, Ma Shilong, Yang Shaoji, and others combined their armies to attack; Tu Erge, Namutai, and Tang Gudai divided the ground and set up defensive posts.
translations.idiomatic: Ming supervising censor Zhang Chun and commanders Zu Dashou, Ma Shilong, Yang Shaoji, and others joined forces to attack; Tu Erge, Namutai, and Tang Gudai divided the terrain and set up defensive posts.

sentences.zh: 明兵攻納穆泰急，圖爾格分兵授裨將阿玉什使赴援。

translations.literal: Ming troops pressed Namutai hard; Tu Erge detached troops and gave them to the deputy commander Ayushi to go to his relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces pressed Namutai hard, so Tu Erge detached troops under deputy commander Ayushi to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 明兵舉火，火將及城樓，有執纛者乘雲梯以登，阿玉什揮刀斬之，奪其纛，明兵稍卻。

translations.literal: Ming troops set fires; the flames nearly reached the gate-tower. A man bearing a standard climbed a cloud-ladder to scale the wall; Ayushi swung his blade and cut him down, seized the standard, and the Ming troops drew back somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops set fires that nearly reached the gate-tower. A standard-bearer climbed a siege ladder; Ayushi struck him down with his blade, seized the standard, and the Ming forces fell back somewhat.

sentences.zh: 阿敏聞明兵攻灤州，遣巴都禮以數百人赴之，夜三鼓，突圍入，明兵發巨砲，城圮，城樓焚。

translations.literal: Amin heard that Ming troops were attacking Luanzhou and sent Baduli with several hundred men. At the third watch of the night they broke through the encirclement and entered; Ming troops fired great cannon, the wall collapsed, and the gate-tower burned.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Ming forces were attacking Luanzhou, Amin sent Baduli with several hundred men. At the third watch they broke through the siege and entered the city; Ming cannon fire collapsed the wall and burned the gate-tower.

sentences.zh: 圖爾格等守四日，度不能禦，率所部夜棄城，為散隊潰圍出。

translations.literal: Tu Erge and the others held for four days, judged that they could not defend, and at night led their divisions to abandon the city, breaking out in scattered parties.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Erge and his colleagues held out four days, then judged the city could not be defended. That night they abandoned it and broke out in scattered parties.

sentences.zh: 會雨，明兵截擊，死者四百餘人。

translations.literal: Rain came; Ming troops intercepted them, and more than four hundred died.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell, and Ming troops intercepted them; more than four hundred were killed.

sentences.zh: 至永平，阿敏遂盡棄諸城，引師出塞，令圖爾格為殿。

translations.literal: When they reached Yongping, Amin abandoned all the cities, led the army out beyond the passes, and made Tu Erge the rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongping, Amin abandoned every city, led the army back beyond the passes, and put Tu Erge in command of the rearguard.

sentences.zh: 師還，命收諸將議罪，上詰責圖爾格、納穆泰等，湯古岱因引罪請死。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the emperor ordered the generals seized for judgment on their offenses. He interrogated Tu Erge, Namutai, and the others; Tang Gudai took blame upon himself and asked for death.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned, the emperor had the generals arrested to deliberate their offenses. He rebuked Tu Erge, Namutai, and the rest; Tang Gudai confessed guilt and asked to die.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「汝等不能全師​​歸，陷於彼為敵所殺，歸至此朕又殺之，於朕復何益？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "You could not bring the whole army back safely. Those left behind were killed by the enemy. If I kill you now that you have returned, what good would that do Me?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You could not bring the whole army home safely. Those you left behind were killed by the enemy. If I kill you now that you have returned, what good would that do me?

sentences.zh: 且汝等既攜俘獲人畜而還，何不收我士卒與之俱來？

translations.literal: And since you already brought back captives, livestock, and goods, why did you not bring back My soldiers with them?
translations.idiomatic: Since you already brought back captives, livestock, and booty, why did you not bring my soldiers back with them?

sentences.zh: 彼等何辜，忍令其呼天搶地以死也！」

translations.literal: What guilt had they, that you could bear to let them die crying to heaven and beating the earth!"
translations.idiomatic: What had they done wrong, that you could bear to let them die wailing to heaven and beating the ground!"

sentences.zh: 圖爾格坐削總兵官，解固山額真。

translations.literal: Tu Erge was punished by having his commander rank stripped and his post as gushan ejen removed.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Erge was punished by stripping his commander rank and removing him from the post of gushan ejen.

sentences.zh: 五年，初設六部，起圖爾格為吏部承政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Six Ministries were first established; Tu Erge was recalled as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, when the Six Ministries were first established, Tu Erge was recalled as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 上自將伐明，攻大凌河，督諸軍合圍，令圖爾格從正白旗固山額真喀克篤禮當城東迤北。

translations.literal: The emperor personally led a campaign against Ming and attacked Greater Linghe, supervising the armies in combined encirclement; Tu Erge was ordered to follow Kekeduli, gushan ejen of the Plain White Banner, to hold the northeast of the city.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally led a campaign against Ming and besieged Greater Linghe, directing the combined encirclement; Tu Erge was ordered to follow Kekeduli of the Plain White Banner and hold the northeast of the city.

sentences.zh: 城兵出攻城南砲台，圖爾格不及騎，徒步擊走之。

translations.literal: Garrison troops came out to attack the cannon emplacement south of the city; Tu Erge had no time to mount and on foot drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops sallied against the southern cannon emplacement; Tu Erge had no time to mount and on foot drove them back.

sentences.zh: 略松山，大凌河旋下。

translations.literal: They raided Songshan, and Greater Linghe soon fell.
translations.idiomatic: They raided Songshan, and Greater Linghe soon surrendered.

sentences.zh: 八年，與固山額真譚泰帥師略錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he and Tan Tai the gushan ejen led troops to raid Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he and gushan ejen Tan Tai led troops on a raid against Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 上自將伐明，命貝勒濟爾哈朗留守，使圖爾格帥師屯張古台河口，防敵自沿海至。

translations.literal: The emperor personally led a campaign against Ming, ordered Prince Jirhalang to remain on guard, and sent Tu Erge to lead troops to encamp at the mouth of the Zhanggutai River to guard against the enemy coming from the coast.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor personally campaigned against Ming, he left Prince Jirhalang in charge and sent Tu Erge to encamp at the mouth of the Zhanggutai River to block enemy forces coming along the coast.

sentences.zh: 既，又使與梅勒額真勞薩帥師出邊，渡遼河，循張古台河駐軍，衛蒙古諸部。

translations.literal: Later he was again sent with meile ejen Laosa to lead troops beyond the border, cross the Liao River, and encamp along the Zhanggutai River to guard the Mongol tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was again sent with meile ejen Laosa to lead troops beyond the border, cross the Liao, and encamp along the Zhanggutai to protect the Mongol tribes.

sentences.zh: 是時察哈爾部林丹汗死，其子額哲不能馭其眾，諸宰桑皆來降。

translations.literal: At this time Lindan Khan of the Chahar died; his son Eje could not control the people, and the zaisangs all came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Lindan Khan of the Chahar died; his son Eje could not control the tribes, and the zaisangs all came over in surrender.

sentences.zh: 九年，命貝勒多爾袞等為帥，納穆泰將右翼，圖爾格將左翼，徇察哈爾，至其庭，額哲遂降。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Princes Dorgon and others were appointed commanders; Namutai led the right wing and Tu Erge the left, marched against the Chahar, reached their court, and Eje then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Princes Dorgon and others were appointed commanders; Namutai led the right wing and Tu Erge the left in a march against the Chahar. They reached the Chahar court, and Eje surrendered.

sentences.zh: 師還，略明邊，自平魯衛入塞，躪代州，乘勝至忻口，遇伏，敗之，逐北至崞縣，殲明兵。

translations.literal: On the return march they raided the Ming border, entered the passes from Pingluwei, overran Daizhou, pressed in victory to Xinkou, met an ambush, defeated it, pursued north to Guo County, and annihilated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march they raided the Ming border, entered through Pingluwei, overran Daizhou, and pressed on to Xinkou. They beat off an ambush, pursued north to Guo County, and destroyed the Ming force.

sentences.zh: 還過平魯衛，明兵邀於途，圖爾格戰，陷陣，得數百級，明兵引入城，不敢出。

translations.literal: Returning past Pingluwei, Ming troops intercepted them on the road; Tu Erge fought, broke into their formation, and took several hundred heads; the Ming troops withdrew into the city and dared not come out.
translations.idiomatic: On the return past Pingluwei, Ming troops blocked the road; Tu Erge fought through their lines and took several hundred heads. The Ming forces withdrew into the city and did not dare come out.

sentences.zh: 圖爾格度追師且至，設伏以待，與納穆泰將千人為殿。

translations.literal: Tu Erge judged that pursuing troops would soon arrive, set an ambush to await them, and with Namutai led a thousand men as rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Erge expected pursuers and set an ambush; he and Namutai led a thousand men as rearguard.

sentences.zh: 明將祖大壽等以三千人赴戰，圖爾格返兵步戰，力衝其中堅，伏起夾擊，明兵大奔，乃徐引兵出塞。

translations.literal: Ming generals Zu Dashou and others came to fight with three thousand men; Tu Erge turned his troops and fought on foot, charged hard at their center, the ambush rose and struck from both sides, the Ming troops fled in disorder, and he then slowly led his army out beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Ming generals Zu Dashou and others advanced with three thousand men. Tu Erge turned back and fought on foot, driving into their center; the ambush rose on both flanks, the Ming army broke and fled, and he then slowly withdrew beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 十年，敘功，授世職一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, for recorded merit, he was granted the hereditary office of first-rank meile janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year his merits were recognized and he received the hereditary rank of first-class meile janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，复授鑲白旗固山額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he was again appointed gushan ejen of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he was again appointed gushan ejen of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，圖爾格率所部自坤都入邊，會於延慶，遂深入，克十六城。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Ajige of Wuying in a campaign against Ming; Tu Erge led his division in from Kundu, joined at Yanqing, then penetrated deep and took sixteen cities.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Ajige of Wuying against Ming; Tu Erge led his division in through Kundu, joined the main force at Yanqing, penetrated deep inland, and captured sixteen cities.

sentences.zh: 攻昌平，下雄縣，圖爾格皆先登。

translations.literal: In the assault on Changping and the capture of Xiong County, Tu Erge was first to scale the walls each time.
translations.idiomatic: At Changping and Xiong County, Tu Erge was first over the wall each time.

sentences.zh: 旋坐女為貝勒尼堪福晉詐取僕女為女，事發，貸死奪官。

translations.literal: Soon after, because his daughter, as consort of Prince Nikan, had fraudulently taken a servant girl and passed her off as her own daughter, when the matter came to light he was spared death but stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, his daughter—as consort of Prince Nikan—was found to have fraudulently passed off a servant girl as her own child. When the affair came to light, Tu Erge was spared death but stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 八月，復命攝固山額真。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was again ordered to act as gushan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was again ordered to serve as acting gushan ejen.

sentences.zh: 四年，上命睿親王多爾袞為奉命大將軍，率師伐明，圖爾格從，擊破明太監馮永盛、總兵侯世祿軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the emperor appointed Prince Dorgon as Grand General by Imperial Command to lead a campaign against Ming; Tu Erge followed and defeated the armies of the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng and the commander Hou Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the emperor appointed Prince Dorgon Grand General by Imperial Command to campaign against Ming. Tu Erge followed and defeated the forces of Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng and commander Hou Shilu.

sentences.zh: 復與固山額真拜音圖敗明兵於董家口，毀邊牆，奪青山關入，下四城。

translations.literal: Again with gushan ejen Bayintu he defeated Ming troops at Dongjiakou, destroyed the border wall, seized entry at Qingshan Pass, and took four cities.
translations.idiomatic: With gushan ejen Bayintu he again defeated Ming troops at Dongjiakou, broke through the border wall, forced Qingshan Pass, and captured four cities.

sentences.zh: 五年，從多爾袞帥師攻錦州，取其禾，屢擊敗明兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Dorgon in leading troops to attack Jinzhou, seized their grain, and repeatedly defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Dorgon against Jinzhou, seized their grain harvest, and repeatedly defeated Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 又與固山額真葉克書將三百人伏烏忻河口，伺城兵出牧，驅牲畜以歸。

translations.literal: Again with gushan ejen Yekešu he led three hundred men in ambush at the mouth of the Wuxin River, waited for garrison troops to come out to pasture, and drove off livestock on the return.
translations.idiomatic: With gushan ejen Yekešu he also led three hundred men in ambush at the Wuxin River mouth, waited for garrison troops to come out grazing, and drove off livestock on the return.

sentences.zh: 明兵千餘人逐戰，葉克書馬中矢蹶，敵將兵焉，圖爾格射敵殪，翼葉克書上馬，並力擊敵，敵敗去復至，凡六合，圖爾格身中二十餘創，猶殿後力戰，護所俘還。

translations.literal: More than a thousand Ming troops pursued and fought; Yekešu's horse was struck by an arrow and fell, and the enemy general pressed him; Tu Erge shot and killed the enemy, helped Yekešu mount, and together they struck the enemy. The enemy was defeated, withdrew, and returned; in all there were six engagements. Tu Erge received more than twenty wounds but still fought in the rearguard and brought the captives back safely.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand Ming troops gave chase. Yekešu's horse was hit and fell, and the enemy general closed in; Tu Erge shot the enemy dead, helped Yekešu remount, and together they drove the enemy back. The Ming force fell back, returned, and fought again—six engagements in all. Tu Erge took more than twenty wounds but still fought as rearguard and brought the captives home safely.

sentences.zh: 敘功，復進世職三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: For recorded merit he was again promoted in hereditary office to third-rank angbang janggin.
translations.idiomatic: His merits were recognized and he was again promoted in hereditary rank to third-class angbang janggin.

sentences.zh: 尋授內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed a Grand Minister of the Interior.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Grand Minister of the Interior.

sentences.zh: 六年，太宗自將伐明，困洪承疇松山，圖爾格從。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming and besieged Hong Chengchou at Songshan; Tu Erge followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Taizong personally campaigned against Ming and besieged Hong Chengchou at Songshan; Tu Erge took part.

sentences.zh: 明總兵曹變蛟夜犯御營，兵至倉卒，守營大臣侍衛皆未集，圖爾格首發矢殪二人，與弟伊爾登、宗室錫翰督親軍攢射，變蛟中創敗去。

translations.literal: Ming commander Cao Bianjiao attacked the imperial camp by night; the troops came suddenly, and the ministers and guards defending the camp had not yet assembled. Tu Erge was first to loose arrows and kill two men; with his younger brother Yierdeng and the imperial clansman Xihan he directed the bodyguard in massed shooting; Bianjiao was wounded and fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Ming commander Cao Bianjiao raided the imperial camp by night. The attack came suddenly before the camp ministers and guards had assembled. Tu Erge was first to shoot and kill two men; with his younger brother Yierdeng and clansman Xihan he directed the bodyguard in volley fire. Bianjiao was wounded and driven off.

sentences.zh: 復從諸貝勒邀擊明敗兵，戰於塔山，為伏於高橋，殺敵無算。

translations.literal: Again he followed the princes in intercepting the defeated Ming troops, fought at Tashan, set an ambush at Gaoqiao, and killed the enemy beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined the princes in intercepting the defeated Ming army, fought at Tashan, laid an ambush at Gaoqiao, and killed countless enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，上命饒餘貝勒阿巴泰為奉命大將軍，以圖爾格副之，帥師伐明。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year the emperor appointed Prince Abatai of Raoyu as Grand General by Imperial Command, with Tu Erge as his deputy, to lead a campaign against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventh year the emperor appointed Prince Abatai of Raoyu Grand General by Imperial Command, with Tu Erge as deputy, to campaign against Ming.

sentences.zh: 左翼道界嶺口，右翼破石城、雁門二關，並深入，越明都，自畿南徇山東，南極兗州，克府三、州十八、縣六十七，獲明魯王以派及樂陵、陽信、東原、安丘、滋陽五郡王，他宗室官屬千餘人。

translations.literal: The left wing went by Jieling Pass, the right wing broke Shicheng and Yanmen passes; both penetrated deep, passed the Ming capital, swept Shandong from south of the capital region, reached as far south as Yanzhou, took three prefectures, eighteen departments, and sixty-seven counties, captured the Ming Prince of Lu Yipai and the five commandery princes of Leling, Yangxin, Dongyuan, Anqiu, and Ziyang, and more than a thousand other members of the imperial clan and officials.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing advanced through Jieling Pass and the right wing broke Shicheng and Yanmen; both columns penetrated deep inland, passed the Ming capital, and swept Shandong from the capital region south to Yanzhou. They captured three prefectures, eighteen departments, and sixty-seven counties, took the Ming Prince of Lu Yipai and five commandery princes of Leling, Yangxin, Dongyuan, Anqiu, and Ziyang, and more than a thousand other imperial clansmen and officials.

sentences.zh: 遇敵三十九戰皆勝，俘三十六萬九千、駝馬騾驢牛羊五十五萬一千三百有奇，得黃金萬二千、白金二百二十萬有奇，珠緞衣裘稱是。

translations.literal: They met the enemy in thirty-nine engagements and won them all, took captive 369,000 persons and 551,300 odd camels, horses, mules, donkeys, cattle, and sheep, and obtained 12,000 taels of gold, more than 2,200,000 taels of silver, and pearls, silks, garments, and furs in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: In thirty-nine engagements they were victorious every time, took 369,000 captives and more than 551,300 camels, horses, mules, donkeys, cattle, and sheep, and seized 12,000 taels of gold, more than 2,200,000 taels of silver, and comparable quantities of pearls, silks, garments, and furs.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，師還，賜白金千五百。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year the army returned and he was granted 1,500 taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year the army returned, and he was granted 1,500 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，敘功，進三等公。

translations.literal: When Shizu took the throne, his merits were recorded and he was promoted to third-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu ascended the throne, his merits were recognized and he was promoted to third-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 順治二年二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the second month of Shunzhi 2 he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second month of Shunzhi 2.

sentences.zh: 九年，諡忠義。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was given the posthumous title Zhongyi (Loyal and Righteous).
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was posthumously titled Zhongyi, Loyal and Righteous.

sentences.zh: 配享太廟，立碑墓道。

translations.literal: He was granted joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and a stele was erected on his tomb road.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and a stele was erected at his tomb.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，定封三等果毅公，世襲。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng he was fixed in rank as third-rank Duke Guoyi, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 his line was fixed as hereditary third-rank Duke Guoyi.

sentences.zh: 子武爾格，從征皮島，戰死；

translations.literal: His son Wu'erge followed the campaign against Pidao and died in battle;
translations.idiomatic: His son Wu'erge joined the campaign against Pidao and was killed in battle;

sentences.zh: 科布梭，襲三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: Kebusuo inherited the third-rank angbang janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Kebusuo inherited the third-rank angbang janggin.

sentences.zh: 貝子屯齊等訐鄭親王濟爾哈朗諸罪狀，因及太宗崩時圖爾格等共謁肅親王豪格，將奉以嗣位，而以上為太子。

translations.literal: Prince Tunqi and others denounced Prince Jirhalang of Zheng for various offenses, and in the course of it mentioned that when Taizong died Tu Erge and others together paid court to Prince Hoge of Su and were about to install him as successor, while making the emperor heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tunqi and others denounced Prince Jirhalang of Zheng on various charges, and in doing so alleged that when Taizong died Tu Erge and others had paid court together to Prince Hoge of Su intending to install him as successor while naming the present emperor heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 王大臣議追奪圖爾格公爵，命但削科布梭世職。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers deliberated on posthumously stripping Tu Erge of his ducal rank; the order was given only to reduce Kebusuo's hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers debated posthumously stripping Tu Erge of his ducal title; in the end only Kebusuo's hereditary rank was reduced.

sentences.zh: 科布梭亦訐其父當太宗崩時，以與白旗諸王有隙，命三牛錄護軍具甲胄弓矢衛其門，其祖母，其父，及其從父遏必隆；

translations.literal: Kebusuo also denounced his father, saying that when Taizong died, because of a rift with the princes of the White Banner he ordered three niru of guards fully armed with armor, bows, and arrows to guard his gate, his grandmother, his father, and his uncle Ebilun;
translations.idiomatic: Kebusuo also denounced his father, alleging that when Taizong died, because of a feud with the White Banner princes he had posted three niru of guards in full armor with bows and arrows to guard his gate, his grandmother, his father, and his uncle Ebilun;

sentences.zh: 又嘗叱辱格格，格格，遏必隆妻也。

translations.literal: and had once reviled and insulted a gege— the gege was Ebilun's wife.
translations.idiomatic: and had once reviled a gege—Ebilun's wife.

sentences.zh: 語詳遏必隆傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in detail in the biography of Ebilun.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in the biography of Ebilun.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，上親政，命科布梭襲三等公，恩詔進二等。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 8, when the emperor took personal rule, Kebusuo was ordered to inherit the third-rank dukedom and, by grace edict, was advanced to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8, when the emperor assumed personal rule, Kebusuo was ordered to inherit the third-rank dukedom and, by grace edict, was promoted to second rank.

sentences.zh: 九年，追論科布梭妄訐其父，削爵。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Kebusuo was retrospectively judged for falsely denouncing his father and stripped of his title.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Kebusuo was judged for falsely denouncing his father and stripped of his title.

sentences.zh: 遏必隆兼襲進一等公，自有傳。

translations.literal: Ebilun inherited jointly and was advanced to first-rank duke; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Ebilun inherited jointly and was advanced to first-rank duke; he has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 兄徹爾格，隸滿洲鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: His elder brother Cheerger was registered in the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Cheerger belonged to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 幼事太祖，從征伐有勞，授備禦，進游擊。

translations.literal: From youth he served the Taizu; for merit on campaigns he was granted the post of guard captain and promoted to commandant.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he served Taizu; for merit on campaign he was made guard captain and promoted to commandant.

sentences.zh: 天命十年四月，上命王善、達珠瑚及徹爾格率千五百人伐瓦爾喀部，王善，上族弟也。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year of Tianming the emperor ordered Wang Shan, Dazhuhu, and Cheerger to lead 1,500 men against the Warka tribe; Wang Shan was a younger clansman of the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Tianming 10 the emperor ordered Wang Shan, Dazhuhu, and Cheerger to lead 1,500 men against the Warka tribe. Wang Shan was a younger kinsman of the emperor.

sentences.zh: 師大捷，多所俘獲。

translations.literal: The army won a great victory and took many captives.
translations.idiomatic: The army won a great victory and took many captives.

sentences.zh: 及還，上先五日出郊獵於避廕，四日乃罷獵，至木戶角洛，與師會。

translations.literal: On the return the emperor had gone out five days earlier to hunt in the suburbs at Biyin; after four days he ended the hunt and at Muhujiaoluo met the army.
translations.idiomatic: On their return the emperor had gone hunting five days earlier at Biyin; after four days he ended the hunt and met the army at Muhujiaoluo.

sentences.zh: 王善等入謁，行抱見禮，以酒二百甕並出獵所獲獸百餘饗從征士卒，並及降人。

translations.literal: Wang Shan and the others entered to pay court, performed the embrace-and-greeting rite, and with two hundred jars of wine and more than a hundred beasts taken on the hunt feasted the soldiers who had gone on campaign, including the surrendered people.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shan and the others paid court with the embrace-and-greeting rite, then with two hundred jars of wine and more than a hundred beasts from the hunt feasted the campaign troops and the surrendered people alike.

sentences.zh: 還至瀋陽北岡，復以酒四百甕、牛羊四十，列四百筵為大宴。

translations.literal: Returning to the northern hill of Shenyang, he again with four hundred jars of wine and forty cattle and sheep set out four hundred banquets for a great feast.
translations.idiomatic: Back at the northern hill of Shenyang, he again laid out four hundred banquets with four hundred jars of wine and forty head of cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 既入城，又賜從征者人白金五兩。

translations.literal: After entering the city he again granted each man who had gone on campaign five taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: After entering the city he granted each campaign soldier five taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 尋進徹爾格三等總兵官。

translations.literal: Soon Cheerger was advanced to third-rank commander.
translations.idiomatic: Cheerger was soon promoted to third-rank commander.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，設八大臣，徹爾格領鑲白旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne the Eight Ministers were established; Cheerger headed the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne and established the Eight Ministers, Cheerger headed the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年正月，從貝勒阿敏等伐朝鮮，師還。

translations.literal: In the first month of Tiancong 1 he followed Prince Amin and others in a campaign against Korea; the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tiancong 1 he joined Prince Amin's campaign against Korea and returned with the army.

sentences.zh: 尋解固山額真授其弟圖爾格。

translations.literal: Soon he resigned as gushan ejen and the post was given to his younger brother Tu Erge.
translations.idiomatic: He soon resigned as gushan ejen in favor of his younger brother Tu Erge.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，從貝勒阿巴泰等伐明，隳錦州、杏山、高橋三城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year he followed Prince Abatai and others in a campaign against Ming and demolished the three cities of Jinzhou, Xingshan, and Gaoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year he joined Prince Abatai against Ming and demolished Jinzhou, Xingshan, and Gaoqiao.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，初設六部，授刑部承政。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, when the Six Ministries were first established, he was appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, when the Six Ministries were established, he was appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 尋遷兵部承政。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 七年八月，命與刑部承政索海偵明邊，至錦州，斬七級，獲把總一、兵九。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year he was ordered with Minister of Punishments Suohai to reconnoiter the Ming border; reaching Jinzhou, he took seven heads and captured one platoon commander and nine soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year he and Minister of Punishments Suohai were ordered to scout the Ming border. At Jinzhou they took seven heads and captured one platoon commander and nine soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十月，明副將尚可喜來降，上命徹爾格偵其踪跡。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Ming deputy commander Shang Kexi came to surrender; the emperor ordered Cheerger to track his movements.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Ming deputy commander Shang Kexi surrendered; the emperor ordered Cheerger to track his movements.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，奏言：「可喜行且至，道遠馬不給，請諸牛錄凡有馬四者，借二以給用。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year he memorialized: "Kexi is on his way and will soon arrive; the road is long and horses are insufficient. I request that in every niru where a household has four horses, two be lent for use."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year he memorialized: "Kexi is on his way, but the road is long and we lack horses. I ask that every niru household with four horses lend two for the journey."

sentences.zh: 崇德二年四月，從武英郡王阿濟格等攻皮島，師還，以屢違軍令，削爵罷官。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Chongde 2 he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying and others in an attack on Pidao; when the army returned, for repeatedly violating military orders he was stripped of rank and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Chongde 2 he joined Prince Ajige's attack on Pidao. When the army returned, he was stripped of rank and dismissed for repeatedly violating military orders.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，更定部院官制，起授工部左參政。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, when the ministry and court offices were reorganized, he was recalled and appointed Left Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, after the ministries were reorganized, he was recalled as Left Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，擢戶部承政。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，考滿，复授牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, at the completion of his term of assessment, he was again granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when his term assessment was complete, he was again granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 世祖定鼎燕京，加半個前程。

translations.literal: When Shizu established the capital at Yanjing, he was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu established the capital at Yanjing, he received half a rank of advancement.

sentences.zh: 順治二年二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, in the second month he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi, he died in the second month.

sentences.zh: 子陳泰、法固達、拉哈達。

translations.literal: His sons were Chentai, Faguda, and Lahada.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Chentai, Faguda, and Lahada.

sentences.zh: 陳泰、拉哈達自有傳。

translations.literal: Chentai and Lahada have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Chentai and Lahada have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 法固達襲世職，進三等阿達哈哈番，尋卒。

translations.literal: Faguda inherited the hereditary office and was advanced to third-rank adahahafan; soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: Faguda inherited the hereditary rank and was promoted to third-rank adahahafan; he died soon after.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登，額亦都第十子，與圖爾格同旗。

translations.literal: Yierdeng—Yierdeng was the tenth son of Eyi'du and of the same banner as Tu Erge.
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng was the tenth son of Eyi'du and belonged to the same banner as Tu Erge.

sentences.zh: 幼，太祖育之宮中，長授侍衛。

translations.literal: As a child he was raised in the palace by the Taizu; when grown he was appointed a guard.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu raised him in the palace as a boy; when he came of age he was appointed an imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 屢從征伐，城界凡、薩爾滸，皆有勞，賚蟒服，授世職游擊。

translations.literal: He repeatedly followed campaigns; at the cities Jiefan and Sarhu he had merit, was granted a python robe, and received the hereditary office of commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly joined campaigns and distinguished himself at Jiefan and Sarhu; he was granted a python robe and a hereditary commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 累進三等副將。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly advanced to third-rank deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to third-rank deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，各旗置大臣二備調遣，伊爾登與其兄圖爾格同佐鑲白旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, two ministers were appointed in each banner to stand ready for dispatch; Yierdeng and his elder brother Tu Erge together assisted the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, each banner received two ministers ready for dispatch, and Yierdeng and his elder brother Tu Erge were assigned together to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 尋命帥師戍國南界。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead troops to garrison the southern frontier of the state.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to lead troops to garrison the southern frontier.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年九月，攻麞子島，島故明將毛文龍所轄，文龍為袁崇煥所殺。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, in the ninth month they attacked Zhangzi Island; the island had formerly been under the Ming general Mao Wenlong, who had been killed by Yuan Chonghuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiancong, in the ninth month they attacked Zhangzi Island, which had been held by the former Ming general Mao Wenlong before Yuan Chonghuan had him killed.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登帥師行略地，得舟四，沉之，俘其人以歸。

translations.literal: Yierdeng led his troops on a raiding march, obtained four boats, sank them, and returned with the captives.
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng led his troops on a raiding expedition, captured four boats and sank them, and returned with prisoners.

sentences.zh: 十月，從伐明，攻龍井關，隳其水門入，斬明將易愛、王遵臣，盡殲其眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he followed the campaign against Ming, attacked Longjing Pass, broke through the water gate to enter, beheaded the Ming generals Yi Ai and Wang Zunchen, and annihilated their force.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined the campaign against Ming, attacked Longjing Pass, broke through the water gate, beheaded the Ming generals Yi Ai and Wang Zunchen, and wiped out their troops.

sentences.zh: 攻遵化，敗明山海關援兵，斬其將趙率教，薄明都。

translations.literal: They attacked Zunhua, defeated Ming reinforcements from Shanhaiguan, beheaded the general Zhao Shuaijiao, and pressed toward the Ming capital.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Zunhua, routed Ming reinforcements from Shanhaiguan, killed the general Zhao Shuaijiao, and pressed toward the Ming capital.

sentences.zh: 四年，克永平、灤州、遵化諸城。

translations.literal: In the fourth year they captured the cities of Yongping, Luanzhou, Zunhua, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year they captured Yongping, Luanzhou, Zunhua, and other cities.

sentences.zh: 師還，進一等副將。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was advanced one rank to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he was promoted one rank to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 圖爾格罷固山額真，以授伊爾登。

translations.literal: Tu Erge was removed as gushan ejen and the post was given to Yierdeng.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Erge was removed from the post of gushan ejen, which was given to Yierdeng.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，攻大凌河城，伊爾登當城東迤南，深溝堅壘，環而守之，卒以破敵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year they attacked Greater Linghe city; Yierdeng held the southeast of the city, dug deep trenches and built strong ramparts, encircled and held it, and in the end broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year they besieged Greater Linghe. Yierdeng held the southeast of the city, dug deep trenches and built strong fortifications, encircled and held the position, and in the end defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 六年，上自將伐察哈爾，命與貝勒阿巴泰等留守。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the emperor personally led a campaign against the Chahar and ordered Yierdeng together with Prince Abatai and others to remain on garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the emperor personally campaigned against the Chahar and ordered Yierdeng, Prince Abatai, and others to remain behind on garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，上以伐明若朝鮮​​若察哈爾三者何先，諭諸貝勒大臣各陳所見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year the emperor asked whether to attack Ming, Korea, or the Chahar first, and instructed the princes and ministers each to state their views.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year the emperor asked whether Ming, Korea, or the Chahar should be attacked first, and instructed the princes and ministers each to give their opinion.

sentences.zh: 時上留諸軍駐山海關外屯田，諸貝勒大臣皆請先用兵於明。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor had the armies stationed outside Shanhaiguan to farm the fields; all the princes and ministers asked to use troops against Ming first.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor had the armies stationed outside Shanhaiguan to open farmland, and all the princes and ministers urged that troops be used against Ming first.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登亦言：「與其頓兵關外，不若徑入內地。

translations.literal: Yierdeng also said: "Rather than keeping the army stalled outside the passes, it would be better to push straight into the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng also said: "Rather than keeping the army stalled outside the passes, we should push straight into the interior.

sentences.zh: 察諸城孰可攻者，多率步兵具梯牌，乘機摧陷，何堅不克？

translations.literal: Examine which cities can be attacked; lead more infantry bearing ladders and shields, seize the opportunity to break through and storm—what stronghold would not fall?
translations.idiomatic: Survey which cities can be taken, lead more infantry with ladders and shields, seize the moment to break in and storm them—what fortress would not fall?

sentences.zh: 況蓄銳已久，人有戰心，及時而用之，所謂事半而功倍也。」

translations.literal: Moreover, troops have long been gathering their edge and men are eager for battle; use them while the moment is right—this is what is called achieving twice the result with half the effort."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the army has long been gathering its edge and the men are eager to fight; use them while the moment is right—that is what is meant by achieving twice the result with half the effort."

sentences.zh: 七月，上命從貝勒岳託、德格類等取旅順，與固山額真葉臣將二千五百人戍焉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the emperor ordered him to follow Princes Yoto and Degelai to take Lüshun, and with gushan ejen Ye Chen he led twenty-five hundred men to garrison the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the emperor ordered him to follow Princes Yoto and Degelai in taking Lüshun, and with gushan ejen Ye Chen he garrisoned the place with twenty-five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 八年，上自將伐明，自上方堡入，命伊爾登從貝勒阿濟格、多爾袞、多鐸等帥師自巴顏硃爾格入龍門，與上軍會宣府，擊敗明兵，得馬百餘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the emperor personally led a campaign against Ming, entering by Fangbao; he ordered Yierdeng to follow Princes Ajige, Dorgon, and Dodo and lead troops from Bayan Zhuge into Longmen, joined the imperial army at Xuanfu, defeated Ming troops, and took over a hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the emperor personally campaigned against Ming, entering by Fangbao. He ordered Yierdeng to follow Princes Ajige, Dorgon, and Dodo and lead troops from Bayan Zhuge through Longmen, join the main army at Xuanfu, defeat Ming forces, and capture more than a hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 攻保安，克之，進拔靈丘。

translations.literal: They attacked Bao'an, took it, and advanced to capture Lingqiu.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Bao'an, captured it, and advanced to take Lingqiu.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登忤諸貝勒，又與固山額真貝子篇古等相詆諆，下法司集讞，坐奪世職，★罷固山額真，复授圖爾格，仍罰鍰。

translations.literal: Yierdeng offended the princes and also exchanged mutual abuse with gushan ejen Prince Pian'gu and others; the case was referred to the judicial office for collective verdict; he was punished by forfeiture of his hereditary office, removal as gushan ejen, restoration of the post to Tu Erge, and yet still fined.
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng offended the princes and exchanged mutual abuse with gushan ejen Prince Pian'gu and others. The case went to the judicial office for collective verdict; he was stripped of his hereditary rank, removed as gushan ejen, the post was restored to Tu Erge, and he was still fined.

sentences.zh: 尋從豫親王多鐸伐朝鮮，師還，復從武英郡王阿濟格攻皮島，坐先軍纛渡江，复罰鍰。

translations.literal: Soon after he followed Prince Dodo of Yu in a campaign against Korea; when the army returned he again followed Prince Ajige of the Wuying Commandery to attack Pik Island and was fined again for crossing the river ahead of the army banner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he followed Prince Dodo of Yu against Korea. When the army returned he again followed Prince Ajige of the Wuying Commandery to attack Pik Island and was fined again for crossing the river ahead of the army banner.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗圍錦州，明總兵洪承疇以師赴援，屯松山西北。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, sixth month, he followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng to besiege Jinzhou; Ming commander-in-chief Hong Chengchou came with troops to relieve it and encamped northwest of Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, sixth month, he followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng to besiege Jinzhou. Ming commander-in-chief Hong Chengchou marched to relieve the city and encamped northwest of Songshan.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王令右翼軍擊之，戰不利，退保乳峰山。

translations.literal: Prince Jirhalang ordered the right wing to attack; the battle went badly and they withdrew to hold Rufeng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jirhalang ordered the right wing to attack, but the battle went badly and they withdrew to hold Rufeng Mountain.

sentences.zh: 敵入兩紅旗、兩藍旗駐軍地，固山額真葉臣等斂兵不與爭。

translations.literal: The enemy entered the encampments of the Two Red Banners and Two Blue Banners; gushan ejen Ye Chen and others gathered their troops and did not contest them.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy entered the camps of the Two Red Banners and Two Blue Banners; gushan ejen Ye Chen and others held their troops back and did not engage.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登將多爾機轄與恭順王孔有德及蒙古敖漢、柰曼、察哈爾諸部兵禦敵，躍馬突陣，縱橫馳擊，身被數創不少卻，馬踣，易之，三戰益奮，明兵凡四合圍，卒潰圍出。

translations.literal: Yierdeng commanded troops under Dorji together with the Gongshun King Kong Youde and Mongol forces from Ao Han, Naiman, Chahar, and other tribes to meet the enemy; he leapt his horse into the enemy ranks and charged back and forth; though wounded several times he did not retreat; his horse fell and he changed mounts; in three battles he fought all the more fiercely; Ming troops four times formed encirclements, and in the end he burst through and got out.
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng led troops under Dorji's command, together with the Gongshun King Kong Youde and Mongol forces from Ao Han, Naiman, Chahar, and other tribes, to meet the enemy. He spurred his horse into the enemy lines and charged back and forth. Though wounded several times he did not fall back; when his horse went down he changed mounts. In three battles he fought all the harder. Ming troops encircled him four times, and in the end he broke through and got out.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其勇，复世職三等梅勒章京，賜白金四百。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his bravery, restored his hereditary rank to third-class meile janggin, and granted four hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his bravery, restored his hereditary rank to third-class meile janggin, and granted four hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 八月，上自將禦洪承疇，陳師松山、杏山間，命諸貝勒大臣分道截擊明兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the emperor personally led forces against Hong Chengchou, arrayed his armies between Songshan and Xingshan, and ordered the princes and ministers to intercept Ming troops by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the emperor personally led forces against Hong Chengchou, deployed his armies between Songshan and Xingshan, and ordered the princes and ministers to intercept Ming troops by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登與公塔瞻率巴牙喇兵為伏於高橋，甫出營，遇明兵千人自杏山潛出，擊斬之，遂至高橋；

translations.literal: Yierdeng and Gong Tahan led bayara troops in ambush at Gaoqiao; they had just left camp when they encountered a thousand Ming troops stealing out from Xingshan; they struck and beheaded them, then proceeded to Gaoqiao;
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng and Gong Tahan led bayara troops in ambush at Gaoqiao. They had just left camp when a thousand Ming troops slipped out from Xingshan; they attacked and cut them down, then moved on to Gaoqiao;

sentences.zh: 又遇明兵六百餘人自杏山南奔塔山，伏起，明兵熸焉。

translations.literal: They again encountered more than six hundred Ming troops fleeing south from Xingshan toward Tashan; the ambush rose and the Ming troops were extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: They again met more than six hundred Ming troops fleeing south from Xingshan toward Tashan; the ambush sprang up and the Ming force was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 上移營逼松山，明將曹變蛟夜犯御營，圖爾格率先射敵，伊爾登與內大臣宗室錫翰整兵拒戰，變蛟敗遁。

translations.literal: The emperor moved camp to press Songshan; Ming commander Cao Bianjiao attacked the imperial camp by night; Tu Erge was first to shoot at the enemy; Yierdeng and inner minister clansman Xihan arrayed troops to resist; Bianjiao was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor moved camp to press Songshan. Ming commander Cao Bianjiao raided the imperial camp by night. Tu Erge was first to shoot at the enemy; Yierdeng and inner minister clansman Xihan formed ranks to resist. Bianjiao was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 上命侍衛大臣疏防及戰不利者皆罰鍰，賞禦敵將士，伊爾登得優賚。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the guard ministers who had been negligent in defense and those who had fought poorly to be fined, rewarded the officers and soldiers who had met the enemy, and Yierdeng received preferential reward.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered guard ministers who had been lax in defense and those who had fought poorly to be fined, rewarded the officers and soldiers who had met the enemy, and gave Yierdeng a generous reward.

sentences.zh: 世祖定燕京，論功，遇恩詔，累進二等伯。

translations.literal: When Shizu established Yanjing as capital, merits were assessed; on benevolent amnesties he was repeatedly advanced to second-class count.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu established the capital at Yanjing, his merits were recognized; on successive benevolent amnesties he was repeatedly promoted to second-class count.

sentences.zh: 順治十三年，以老致仕。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Shunzhi he retired on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 13 he retired on account of age.

sentences.zh: 上旌伊爾登功，命得乘馬入朝，輒召對賜食。

translations.literal: The emperor honored Yierdeng's achievements, allowing him to enter court on horseback, and whenever summoned for audience would confer food.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor honored Yierdeng's service, permitted him to enter court on horseback, and whenever summoned would converse with him and grant him a meal.

sentences.zh: 圖其像，一藏內庫，一畀其家，

translations.literal: His portrait was painted; one copy was stored in the inner treasury, one given to his family.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was painted; one copy was kept in the inner treasury and one given to his family.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，卒，諡忠直。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi, he died and was posthumously titled Zhongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kangxi, he died and was posthumously titled Zhongzhi.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登勇冠諸軍，尤長於應變，潛機制敵，諸宿將皆弗能及。

translations.literal: Yierdeng's bravery ranked first among the armies; he was especially skilled at adapting to circumstances and seizing hidden opportunities to control the enemy—veteran generals could not match him.
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng's courage ranked first in the army. He was especially skilled at adapting to circumstances and seizing hidden opportunities to control the enemy; veteran generals could not match him.

sentences.zh: 子前卒，孫噶都襲，官至鑲黃旗蒙古副都統、領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: His son had died earlier; his grandson Gadu inherited the rank, reaching the posts of Mongol deputy commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and chief guard of the inner guard.
translations.idiomatic: His son had died earlier; his grandson Gadu inherited the rank and rose to Mongol deputy commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and chief guard of the inner guard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等男。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign the enfeoffment was fixed as first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign the enfeoffment was fixed as first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 超哈爾，徹爾格弟，與同旗。

translations.literal: Chaohar, younger brother of Che'erge, was of the same banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chaohar, younger brother of Che'erge, belonged to the same banner.

sentences.zh: 幼事太祖，授牛錄額真，

translations.literal: From youth he served the Taizu and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he served Taizu and was appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，予牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, he was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiancong, he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 九年，與牛錄額真納海、巴雅、彰屯等齎書詣喜峰口、潘家口、董家口諸處諭明守邊將吏，還遇戍卒邀戰，斬獲百餘人，擢巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, with niru ejen Nihai, Baya, Zhangtun, and others he carried letters to Xifengkou, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou and other places to instruct Ming frontier commanders and officials; on the return they met garrison troops who blocked the way for battle; they beheaded and captured over a hundred men and he was promoted to bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he went with niru ejen Nihai, Baya, Zhangtun, and others carrying letters to Xifengkou, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou, and other passes to instruct Ming frontier commanders and officials. On the return they met garrison troops who blocked the way; they killed and captured more than a hundred men, and he was promoted to bayara jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，將入邊，遇邏卒，迎戰，俘二人，獲馬四。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Ajige of the Wuying Commandery to campaign against Ming; as they were about to cross the border they met frontier patrols, met them in battle, captured two men, and took four horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ajige of the Wuying Commandery against Ming. As they were about to enter the border they met frontier patrols, fought them, captured two men, and took four horses.

sentences.zh: 薄明都，奪砲以擊敵，殺百餘人。

translations.literal: Pressing the Ming capital, they seized cannon to bombard the enemy and killed over a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing toward the Ming capital, they seized cannon to fire on the enemy and killed more than a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 轉戰至盧溝橋，再遇敵，戰皆勝。

translations.literal: Fighting on to the Lugou Bridge, they met the enemy again twice and won both battles.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting on to the Lugou Bridge, they met the enemy twice more and won both engagements.

sentences.zh: 二年，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the second year he was ranked among the deliberative ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was ranked among the deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，更定部院官制，授禮部左參政。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year the ministerial and bureau establishment was reformed and he was appointed left vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year the ministries and bureaus were reorganized, and he was appointed left vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 九月，從睿親王多爾袞伐明，自青石口入邊，會師涿州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he followed Prince Regent Dorgon to campaign against Ming, entering the border by Qingshikou, and joined the main army at Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he followed Prince Regent Dorgon against Ming, entered the border by Qingshikou, and joined the main army at Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 超哈爾率所部攻任丘，穴地隳其城，趨趙北口，明兵毀橋，師不得渡，乃騎出水西襲明兵後，明兵大敗。

translations.literal: Chaohar led his division to attack Renqiu, undermined and breached the wall, and pressed toward Zhaobeikou; Ming troops destroyed the bridge and the army could not cross; he then rode out west of the water to strike the Ming rear; the Ming army was greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Chaohar led his division to attack Renqiu, undermined and breached the wall, and pressed toward Zhaobeikou. Ming troops destroyed the bridge and the army could not cross, so he rode out west of the river to strike the Ming rear. The Ming army was routed.

sentences.zh: 南略山東，從克濟南。

translations.literal: They raided south into Shandong and followed in the capture of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: They raided south into Shandong and helped capture Jinan.

sentences.zh: 四年春，師還，出邊，超哈爾殿，敗明兵於太平寨。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year the army returned; as it left the border Chaohar served as rear guard and defeated Ming troops at Taipingzhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, as the army withdrew from the border, Chaohar served as rear guard and defeated Ming troops at Taipingzhai.

sentences.zh: 五年，轉兵部右參政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to right vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to right vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 六年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗伐明，圍錦州，城兵出戰，超哈爾率所部奮擊，逐入郭，力戰沒於陣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng to campaign against Ming and besiege Jinzhou; city troops came out to fight; Chaohar led his division in fierce attack, drove them back inside the wall, and fell in battle after fighting hard.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Prince Jirhalang of Zheng against Ming to besiege Jinzhou. When city troops came out to fight, Chaohar led his division in a fierce assault, drove them back inside the wall, and died fighting in the field.

sentences.zh: 太宗深惜之，賜白金六百一十兩，進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Taizong deeply regretted his loss, granted six hundred ten taels of white silver, and advanced his hereditary rank to second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong deeply mourned his loss, granted six hundred ten taels of silver, and advanced his hereditary rank to second-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治間，追諡果壯，立碑紀績。

translations.literal: In the Shunzhi period he was posthumously titled Guozhuang and a stele was erected to record his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shunzhi period he was posthumously titled Guozhuang and a stele was erected to commemorate his achievements.

sentences.zh: 子格黑禮、額赫里。

translations.literal: His sons were Geheli and Eheli.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Geheli and Eheli.

sentences.zh: 格黑禮襲世職，凡四年而卒。

translations.literal: Geheli inherited the hereditary office and died after four years.
translations.idiomatic: Geheli inherited the hereditary rank and died after four years.

sentences.zh: 額赫里以牛錄額真襲世職，尋遷甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Eheli inherited the hereditary office as niru ejen and was soon transferred to jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Eheli inherited the hereditary rank as niru ejen and was soon transferred to jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 從鄭親王濟爾哈朗徇湖廣，屢敗明兵。

translations.literal: Following Prince Jirhalang of Zheng he pacified Huguang and repeatedly defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: Following Prince Jirhalang of Zheng he pacified Huguang and repeatedly defeated Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 師還，授京城中城理事官。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was appointed administrator of the inner city of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was appointed administrator of the capital's inner city.

sentences.zh: 遷都察院理事官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to administrator of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to administrator of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 累進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly advanced to second-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to second-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，命帥師戍江寧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi he was ordered to lead troops to garrison Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 he was ordered to lead troops to garrison Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 鄭成功侵福建，駐軍海澄。

translations.literal: Zheng Chenggong invaded Fujian and encamped at Haicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Chenggong invaded Fujian and encamped at Haicheng.

sentences.zh: 平南將軍金礪請益師進剿，上命額赫里將千五百人以往，與金礪會師擊成功，大破之，遂攻海澄，复敗成功兵。

translations.literal: Pacifying-the-South General Jin Liang requested reinforcements to pursue and suppress; the emperor ordered Eheli to lead fifteen hundred men there; he joined Jin Liang, defeated Chenggong in a great battle, then attacked Haicheng and again defeated Chenggong's troops.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-the-South General Jin Liang requested reinforcements for pursuit and suppression. The emperor ordered Eheli to lead fifteen hundred men there; he joined Jin Liang, routed Chenggong, then attacked Haicheng and defeated Chenggong's forces again.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 以功進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to first-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was promoted to first-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，成功兵逼江寧，給事中楊雍建劾樞臣失職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Chenggong's troops pressed Jiangning; censor Yang Yongjian impeached the high ministers for dereliction.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Chenggong's troops threatened Jiangning; censor Yang Yongjian impeached the high ministers for dereliction of duty.

sentences.zh: 明年，甄別部院諸臣，上以額赫里弗任勞怨，解任，降三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: The following year, in sorting the ministers of the ministries and bureaus, the emperor considered Eheli unable to bear labor and complaints, relieved him of his post, and reduced him to third-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when the ministers of the ministries and bureaus were sorted for fitness, the emperor judged Eheli unable to bear hardship and complaint, relieved him of office, and reduced him to third-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，復為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi reign he was again made vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kangxi reign he was again appointed vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子英素襲。

translations.literal: His son Yingsu inherited the rank.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yingsu inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 從征準噶爾有功，進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Serving on the campaign against the Zunghars he had merit and was advanced to second-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He served on the campaign against the Zunghars with merit and was promoted to second-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 卒，子郎保仍襲三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He died; his son Langbao still inherited third-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He died; his son Langbao inherited third-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 從大將軍傅爾丹徵準噶爾，和通呼爾之敗，郎保殉焉，卹進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Following Grand General Furdan on the expedition against the Zunghars, at the defeat at Khorgos Langbao died in battle; condolence promotion to second-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Following Grand General Furdan against the Zunghars, Langbao died in the defeat at Khorgos; he was posthumously advanced to second-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 巴奇蘭，納喇氏，世居伊巴丹。

translations.literal: Baqilan—Baqilan, of the Nara clan, originally from Yibadan.
translations.idiomatic: Baqilan was of the Nara clan and originally from Yibadan.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲鑲紅旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 太祖兵初起，巴奇蘭率眾來歸。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Taizu's military rise Baqilan led his followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taizu's military rise Baqilan led his followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 屢從征伐，沙嶺之役，率五牛錄兵當前鋒，敗敵。

translations.literal: He repeatedly joined campaigns; at the battle of Shaling he led five niru as vanguard and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly joined campaigns. At the battle of Shaling he led five niru as vanguard and defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 天命十一年，從攻寧遠，克覺華島，授游擊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianming he followed the attack on Ningyuan, captured Juehua Island, and was appointed commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 11 he joined the attack on Ningyuan, captured Juehua Island, and was appointed commandant.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，各旗設調遣大臣二，巴奇蘭佐正黃旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, two dispatch ministers were set in each banner; Baqilan assisted the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, each banner received two dispatch ministers, and Baqilan was assigned to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，太宗自將伐明，貝勒濟爾哈朗留守，巴奇蘭副之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming; Prince Jirhalang remained on guard and Baqilan served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year Taizong personally campaigned against Ming. Prince Jirhalang remained on guard, and Baqilan served as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命偕薩穆什喀分將左右翼兵伐虎爾哈諸部，師行，上諭之曰：「此行道殊遠，慎毋憚勞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was ordered together with Samuska to divide command of the left and right wing troops to campaign against the Jurchen tribes of the Hurka; as the army set out the emperor instructed them: "This route is exceedingly distant—take care not to shrink from hardship.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was ordered together with Samuska to divide command of the left and right wings against the Hurka tribes. As the army set out the emperor instructed them: "This route is exceedingly distant—take care not to shrink from hardship.

sentences.zh: 得俘，撫以善言，與共甘苦。

translations.literal: When you take captives, comfort them with kind words and share hardships with them.
translations.idiomatic: When you take captives, comfort them with kind words and share their hardships.

sentences.zh: 攜以還，皆可為我用。

translations.literal: Bring them back with you and all can be put to our use.
translations.idiomatic: Bring them back with you and all can serve our cause.

sentences.zh: 汝曹當善體朕意。」

translations.literal: You must earnestly heed my intent."
translations.idiomatic: You must earnestly carry out my intent."

sentences.zh: 九年五月，師還，上御殿設宴，親酌金卮勞之，分賚所獲牲畜，命籍降人二千餘戶俾安業，進一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year the army returned; the emperor held court, set a banquet, personally poured golden goblets to reward them, distributed the livestock captured, ordered more than two thousand surrendered households registered for settlement, and advanced him one rank to meile janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year the army returned. The emperor held court and set a banquet, personally poured golden goblets to reward them, distributed the captured livestock, registered more than two thousand surrendered households for settlement, and promoted him one rank to meile janggin.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，病創潰，卒，贈三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year his old wound broke open; he died and was posthumously granted third-class angban janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year his old wound reopened; he died and was posthumously granted third-class angban janggin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等子。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign the enfeoffment was fixed as third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign the enfeoffment was fixed as third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 巴奇蘭伐虎爾哈諸部，牛錄額真岱松阿實從。

translations.literal: When Baqilan campaigned against the Hurka tribes, niru ejen Daisong'a actually accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: When Baqilan campaigned against the Hurka tribes, niru ejen Daisong'a accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 岱松阿，佟佳氏，世居雅爾湖。

translations.literal: Daisong'a—Daisong'a, of the Tongjia clan, originally from Ya'erhu.
translations.idiomatic: Daisong'a was of the Tongjia clan and originally from Ya'erhu.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲正紅旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 初亦逮事太祖。

translations.literal: At first he also served the Taizu in his youth.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he also served Taizu.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，從伐明錦州，下十三站以東二十餘台。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against Ming at Jinzhou and took more than twenty forts east of the Thirteen Stations.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2 he joined the campaign against Ming at Jinzhou and captured more than twenty forts east of the Thirteen Stations.

sentences.zh: 七年，命與甲喇額真英俄爾岱使朝鮮。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered together with jalan ejen Enggūrdai to mission to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was ordered together with jalan ejen Enggūrdai on a mission to Korea.

sentences.zh: 語見英俄爾岱傳。

translations.literal: The account appears in Enggūrdai's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account appears in Enggūrdai's biography.

sentences.zh: 八年，予牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 及巴奇蘭等師還，有功，加半個前程。

translations.literal: When Baqilan and the others returned from campaign, for merit he received half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: When Baqilan and the others returned from campaign, he was rewarded with half a rank of advancement for his service.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從英親王阿濟格伐明，徇昌平。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Ajige of Ying in a campaign against Ming and swept through Changping.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ajige of Ying against Ming and swept through Changping.

sentences.zh: 二年，戍海州，擊明兵旅順口，得舟二，俘七人，斬二人，命賚銀布。

translations.literal: In the second year he garrisoned Haizhou, attacked Ming troops at Lüshunkou, took two boats, captured seven men, beheaded two, and was ordered rewarded with silver and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he garrisoned Haizhou, attacked Ming troops at Lüshunkou, seized two boats, captured seven men, killed two, and was rewarded with silver and cloth.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 阿納海，岱松阿子，襲職，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Anahai, son of Daisong'a, inherited the post and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Anahai, Daisong'a's son, inherited the post and was appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，從擊李自成，逐至富池口，掠其舟。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi he followed in an attack on Li Zicheng, pursued him to Fuchikou, and seized his boats.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 he joined the attack on Li Zicheng, pursued him to Fuchikou, and captured his boats.

sentences.zh: 三年，從擊張獻忠。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed in an attack on Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 師至西安，叛將賀珍以馬步二千人拒守雞頭關，阿納海與巴牙喇纛章京鰲拜等擊破賊壘，遂徇四川，屢破獻忠兵。

translations.literal: When the army reached Xi'an, the rebel general He Zhen with two thousand cavalry and infantry held Jitou Pass; Anahai, together with bayara da janggin Oboi and others, stormed and broke the rebel fortifications, then swept through Sichuan and repeatedly defeated Xianzhong's troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Xi'an, the rebel general He Zhen held Jitou Pass with two thousand horse and foot. Anahai, bayara da janggin Oboi, and others broke the rebel fortifications, then swept through Sichuan and repeatedly defeated Xianzhong's forces.

sentences.zh: 五年，授工部理事官，尋兼任甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed an executive officer of the Board of Works and soon also served concurrently as jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made an executive officer of the Board of Works and soon also served as jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 六年，從討叛將薑瓖，攻大同，掘塹環城，城兵出戰，阿納海及固山額真噶達渾與戰屢勝。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed in the suppression of the rebel general Jiang Xiang, attacked Datong, dug trenches to encircle the city, and when city troops came out to fight Anahai and gushan ejen Gadahun fought repeatedly and won.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against the rebel general Jiang Xiang at Datong. Trenches were dug to encircle the city; when the garrison sallied, Anahai and gushan ejen Gadahun fought them repeatedly and won.

sentences.zh: 敘功，並遇恩詔，累進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were recorded; he also benefited from an amnesty edict and was repeatedly advanced to first-class adahahafan.
translations.idiomatic: His merits were recognized; he also benefited from an amnesty edict and was promoted by stages to first-class adahahafan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從靖東將軍濟席哈討山東土寇於七，敗其黨喬玉季於連山，賊夜出，阿納海與戰，中創卒，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he followed General for Pacifying the East Jixiha in suppressing Shandong bandits at Yuqi, defeated their associate Qiao Yuji at Lianshan, and when the bandits stole out by night Anahai fought them, was wounded, and died; he was posthumously advanced to third-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he followed General for Pacifying the East Jixiha against Shandong bandits at Yuqi and defeated their associate Qiao Yuji at Lianshan. When the bandits raided by night, Anahai fought them, was wounded, and died; he was posthumously promoted to third-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 巴漢，亦岱松阿子，襲職。

translations.literal: Bahan, also a son of Daisong'a, inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: Bahan, another son of Daisong'a, inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，以參領從副都統碩塔、穆森等討耿精忠。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, serving as assistant commandant, he followed Deputy Lieutenant General Shuota, Muksen, and others in suppressing Geng Jingzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13, as assistant commandant he followed Deputy Lieutenant General Shuota, Muksen, and others against Geng Jingzhong.

sentences.zh: 次安慶，聞建德陷，巴漢率兵诇之。

translations.literal: When they reached Anqing and heard that Jiande had fallen, Bahan led troops to reconnoiter.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Anqing and learned that Jiande had fallen, Bahan led troops to reconnoiter.

sentences.zh: 至赤頭關，精忠兵出戰，擊之潰，遂導諸軍攻克之。

translations.literal: At Chitou Pass Jingzhong's troops came out to fight; he struck and routed them, then guided the army to capture the place.
translations.idiomatic: At Chitou Pass, Jingzhong's troops came out to fight; he routed them and then guided the army to take the pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月，精忠兵四千餘攻南康，巴漢從碩塔、穆森等擊敗之，斬千餘，盡收其械。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month more than four thousand of Jingzhong's troops attacked Nankang; Bahan followed Shuota, Muksen, and others in defeating them, beheaded more than a thousand, and seized all their weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month more than four thousand of Jingzhong's troops attacked Nankang. Bahan, with Shuota, Muksen, and others, defeated them, killed more than a thousand, and captured all their arms.

sentences.zh: 十六年，從鎮南將軍莽依圖、江寧將軍額楚等討吳三桂，自廣東徇廣西，破三桂將蔣雄於樹梓墟。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he followed Pacifying-the-South General Mangyitu, Jiangning General Echu, and others in suppressing Wu Sangui, swept through Guangxi from Guangdong, and defeated Sangui's general Jiang Xiong at Shuzixu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he followed Pacifying-the-South General Mangyitu, Jiangning General Echu, and others against Wu Sangui, marched through Guangxi from Guangdong, and defeated Sangui's general Jiang Xiong at Shuzixu.

sentences.zh: 十八年，三桂將吳世琮攻南寧，巴漢從莽依圖等赴援，世琮屯新寧州西山下，列鹿角為陣。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Sangui's general Wu Shigong attacked Nanning; Bahan followed Mangyitu and others to the relief; Shigong encamped below Xishan in Xinning Prefecture and formed a battle line with abatis.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Sangui's general Wu Shigong attacked Nanning. Bahan followed Mangyitu to the relief. Shigong encamped below West Mountain in Xinning Prefecture and formed a line with abatis.

sentences.zh: 巴漢與戰，多所俘馘​​，世琮負傷引去。

translations.literal: Bahan fought him, killed and captured many, and Shigong, wounded, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Bahan engaged him, killed and captured many, and Shigong withdrew wounded.

sentences.zh: 南寧圍解。

translations.literal: The siege of Nanning was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The siege of Nanning was raised.

sentences.zh: 二十年，從征南大將軍賴塔進兵，敗三桂將何繼祖等於西隆州，奪石門坎、黃草壩諸隘，遂趨曲靖。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he followed Pacifying-the-South Grand General Laita in advancing the army, defeated Sangui's generals He Jizu and others at Xilong Prefecture, seized the passes at Shimenkan, Huangcao Dam, and elsewhere, and then pressed toward Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he followed Pacifying-the-South Grand General Laita in the advance, defeated Sangui's generals He Jizu and others at Xilong Prefecture, took the passes at Shimenkan, Huangcao Dam, and elsewhere, and pressed on toward Qujing.

sentences.zh: 會湖南、四川兩路兵，進克雲南。

translations.literal: He joined the armies of Hunan and Sichuan in advancing to capture Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Hunan and Sichuan columns in capturing Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 復從都統希福擊三桂將馬寶、巴養元等於楚雄烏木山。

translations.literal: He again followed Banner Commander-in-Chief Xifu in attacking Sangui's generals Ma Bao, Ba Yangyuan, and others at Wumu Mountain in Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Banner Commander-in-Chief Xifu against Sangui's generals Ma Bao, Ba Yangyuan, and others at Wumu Mountain in Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，論功，進一等阿思哈尼哈番。
