translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year his merits were assessed and he was advanced to first-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year his merits were recognized and he was promoted to first-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 二十九年三月，卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third month of the twenty-ninth year.

sentences.zh: 齊爾格申，世居寧古塔，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Qi Ergeshen—Qi Ergeshen, whose family had long lived at Ningguta, took the place as his clan name.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ergeshen was a man whose family had long lived at Ningguta and who took the place as his clan name.

sentences.zh: 兄納林率百餘人歸太祖，太祖命籍其眾為牛錄，以為牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His elder brother Nalin led more than a hundred men to submit to the Taizu; the Taizu ordered their followers registered as a niru and made Nalin niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Nalin led more than a hundred men to submit to Taizu, who registered their followers as a niru and made Nalin niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲鑲白旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 納林卒，齊爾格申代為牛錄額真，率所部屯達卜遜木城。

translations.literal: When Nalin died, Qi Ergeshen replaced him as niru ejen and led his division to garrison Tabuxun Wood Fort.
translations.idiomatic: When Nalin died, Qi Ergeshen succeeded him as niru ejen and led his division to garrison Tabuxun Wood Fort.

sentences.zh: 明兵攻耀州，齊爾格申赴援，敗之淤泥河，還駐平山。

translations.literal: When Ming troops attacked Yaozhou, Qi Ergeshen went to the relief, defeated them at the Niyu River, and returned to encamp at Pingshan.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming troops attacked Yaozhou, Qi Ergeshen marched to the relief, defeated them at the Niyu River, and returned to encamp at Pingshan.

sentences.zh: 海濱鬻鹽者千人，具舟將出海，齊爾格申夜襲之，千人皆殪。

translations.literal: A thousand salt sellers on the coast fitted out boats and were about to put to sea; Qi Ergeshen raided them by night and all thousand were killed.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand coastal salt traders fitted out boats to put to sea; Qi Ergeshen raided them by night and killed them all.

sentences.zh: 明錦州守者以兵至，齊爾格申與戰，面中槍，戰愈力，明兵敗去。

translations.literal: The Jinzhou garrison of Ming came with troops; Qi Ergeshen fought them, was struck in the face by a musket shot, fought all the harder, and the Ming troops were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jinzhou garrison came out against him, Qi Ergeshen fought them, took a musket ball in the face, fought all the harder, and drove the Ming troops off.

sentences.zh: 天聰六年，修蓋州城，移民以實之，命齊爾格申與梅勒額真石國柱、甲喇額真雅什塔等帥師戍焉。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiancong Gaizhou city was repaired and people were moved in to fill it; Qi Ergeshen was ordered, together with meile ejen Shiguozhu, jalan ejen Yashta, and others, to lead troops to garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 6 Gaizhou was rebuilt and settlers were moved in to fill it. Qi Ergeshen, meile ejen Shiguozhu, jalan ejen Yashta, and others were ordered to garrison the city.

sentences.zh: 八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 蓋州與明為界，諸新附多亡去歸於明。

translations.literal: Gaizhou bordered Ming territory, and many of the newly submitted fled away to return to Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Gaizhou lay on the border with Ming, and many of the newly submitted fled back to Ming.

sentences.zh: 齊爾格申將兵行海濱，值明兵以舟迎逃人，已入海。

translations.literal: Qi Ergeshen led troops along the coast and encountered Ming troops in boats receiving fugitives who had already put out to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ergeshen led troops along the coast and found Ming boats already at sea taking fugitives aboard.

sentences.zh: 齊爾格申涉水追射，殪舟中執槍者及逃人一，遂躍入其舟，獲明備禦一、邏卒十有三。

translations.literal: Qi Ergeshen waded into the water, pursued, and shot; he killed the man with the musket in the boat and one fugitive, then leaped into the boat and captured one Ming frontier defender and thirteen border patrol soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ergeshen waded in, pursued, and shot, killing the musketeer in the boat and one fugitive. He then leaped into the boat and captured one Ming frontier defender and thirteen border patrol soldiers.

sentences.zh: 又將兵視北新渡口，諜言明兵以舟五十餘泊島中，命為伏以待，明兵二十餘入島伐木，伏發，盡獲之。

translations.literal: He again led troops to inspect Beixin Ford; spies reported that more than fifty Ming boats were moored on an island, and he ordered an ambush set; when more than twenty Ming troops entered the island to cut wood the ambush was sprung and all were captured.
translations.idiomatic: He again led troops to inspect Beixin Ford. Spies reported more than fifty Ming boats moored on an island; he set an ambush, and when more than twenty Ming soldiers entered the island to cut timber the trap was sprung and all were taken.

sentences.zh: 明兵以舟泛於海，有二人遙呼曰：「我逃人也，誰敢逐我者？」

translations.literal: Ming troops were drifting on the sea in boats; two men shouted from afar: "We are fugitives—who dares pursue us?"
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops were adrift at sea in boats when two men shouted from afar: "We are fugitives—who dares pursue us?"

sentences.zh: 齊爾格申乘小舟逐之，斬一人，俘一人，餘舟明兵皆驚潰。

translations.literal: Qi Ergeshen took a small boat in pursuit, beheaded one man and captured one; the remaining Ming boats all scattered in panic.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ergeshen gave chase in a small boat, killed one man and captured another; the rest of the Ming boats fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，以齊爾格申出戍能稱職，賜良馬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, because Qi Ergeshen had performed his frontier garrison duties capably, he was granted a fine horse.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1, because Qi Ergeshen had served well on frontier garrison duty, he was granted a fine horse.

sentences.zh: 五月，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，薄大同，徇延慶，有所俘獲。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying in a campaign against Ming, pressed close to Datong, swept through Yanqing, and took captives and booty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying against Ming, pressed toward Datong, swept through Yanqing, and captured prisoners and booty.

sentences.zh: 世祖朝為福陵總管。

translations.literal: In the reign of Shizu he served as superintendent of Fuling.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shizu he served as superintendent of Fuling.

sentences.zh: 順治七年，授世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shunzhi he was granted the hereditary office of tosahahafan.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 7 he received the hereditary rank of tosahahafan.

sentences.zh: 齊爾格申從弟多尼喀，以攻萊陽先登，賜號「巴圖魯」，授世職牛錄章京，加半個前程，至是卒，以齊爾格申兼襲為一等阿達哈哈番，复以恩詔進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Qi Ergeshen's younger cousin Donika, for leading the escalade in the attack on Laiyang, was granted the title "Baturu" and the hereditary office of niru janggin with half a rank of advancement; when he died at this time Qi Ergeshen also inherited in his place as first-class adahahafan, and again, by amnesty edict, was advanced to third-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ergeshen's younger cousin Donika, who had led the escalade at Laiyang, had been granted the title Baturu and the hereditary rank of niru janggin with half a rank of advancement. When Donika died, Qi Ergeshen inherited in his place as first-class adahahafan and, under an amnesty edict, was further promoted to third-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 12.

sentences.zh: 巴都裡，性佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Baduri—Baduri, of the Xingjia clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Baduri was a Manchu of the Xingjia clan in the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 父剛格，當太祖時率其族來歸。

translations.literal: His father Gangge, in the time of the Taizu, led their clan to submit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gangge led their clan to submit in Taizu's time.

sentences.zh: 巴都裡屢從戰伐，授牛錄額真，兼甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Baduri repeatedly joined campaigns and was appointed niru ejen, also serving as jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Baduri repeatedly joined campaigns and was appointed niru ejen, also serving as jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，從伐明，攻大同，與宗室拜音圖為導，未入邊，得察哈爾宰桑四，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he followed a campaign against Ming and attacked Datong; with the imperial clansman Bayintu as guide, before crossing the border he took four Chahar zaisang and was promoted to bayara da janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he joined the campaign against Ming and attacked Datong. With the imperial clansman Bayintu as guide, he captured four Chahar zaisang before crossing the border and was promoted to bayara da janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮，巴都裡與巴牙喇纛章京鞏阿岱圍南漢山城，屢敗敵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed a campaign against Korea; Baduri, together with bayara da janggin Gongadai, besieged Namhansanseong and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he joined the campaign against Korea. Baduri and bayara da janggin Gongadai besieged Namhansanseong and repeatedly defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 二年，從上獵葉赫，巴都裡及哈寧阿所部行列不整，上嚴詰責之。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed the emperor on a hunt in Yehe; the ranks of Baduri and Haning'a's division were disorderly, and the emperor sternly rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he accompanied the emperor on a hunt in Yehe. The ranks of Baduri and Haning'a's division fell out of order, and the emperor sternly rebuked them.

sentences.zh: 三年，從伐明。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed a campaign against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined a campaign against Ming.

sentences.zh: 明年，從濟南還，師出青山口，明師追至，巴都裡率所部還戰，巴牙喇兵有被創墜馬者，令他兵護以歸，棄於道，坐罰鍰。

translations.literal: The following year, returning from Jinan, the army went out by Qingshan Pass; Ming troops pursued to the rear; Baduri led his division to turn and fight; among the bayara troops some who were wounded fell from their horses, and he had other soldiers escort them back but abandoned them on the road; for this he was fined.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, returning from Jinan, the army exited by Qingshan Pass with Ming troops in pursuit. Baduri led his division to turn and fight. When wounded bayara soldiers fell from their horses, he had others escort them back but left them on the road; he was fined for it.

sentences.zh: 六年，授兵部參政，兼任鑲藍旗滿洲梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed vice minister of the Board of War and also served concurrently as meile ejen of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made vice minister of the Board of War and also served as meile ejen of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，與梅勒額真鄂羅塞臣伐黑龍江，降圖瑚勒禪諸城。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, together with meile ejen Orosechen, he campaigned against the Amur River region and received the surrender of the cities of Tuhulchan and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he campaigned against the Amur River region with meile ejen Orosechen and received the surrender of Tuhulchan and other cities.

sentences.zh: 師還，予世職半個前程。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted half a rank of hereditary advancement.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was granted half a rank of hereditary advancement.

sentences.zh: 遷鑲藍旗滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: He was transferred to gushan ejen of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to gushan ejen of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 海都，其從弟杭嘉子也，襲職。

translations.literal: Haidu, son of his younger cousin Hengjing, inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: Haidu, son of his younger cousin Hengjing, inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 恩詔，進拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: By amnesty edict he was advanced to baitalabur hafan with an additional tosahahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under an amnesty edict he was promoted to baitalabur hafan with an additional tosahahafan.

sentences.zh: 順治間，從擊明將孫可望、李定國、白文選，皆有功。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign he followed in attacks on the Ming generals Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and Bai Wenxuan and had merit in each.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign he fought the Ming generals Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and Bai Wenxuan and distinguished himself in each campaign.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，署護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi reign he served as acting commander of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi reign he served as acting Guard commander.

sentences.zh: 從討吳三桂，卒於軍。

translations.literal: He followed in the suppression of Wu Sangui and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Wu Sangui and died in the field.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His merits were recorded and he was advanced to third-class adahahafan.
translations.idiomatic: His merits were recognized and he was posthumously promoted to third-class adahahafan.

sentences.zh: 托克雅，先世居瑚爾哈，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Tokoya—Tokoya, whose forebears had long lived at Hurka, took the place as his clan name.
translations.idiomatic: Tokoya was a man whose forebears had long lived at Hurka and who took the place as his clan name.

sentences.zh: 兄納罕泰，為瑚爾哈部屯長，天命四年，將其戚屬及所部百餘戶來歸，太祖使迎勞賜宴，賚裘服、奴僕、田宅、器用、牛馬。

translations.literal: His elder brother Nahan Tai was headman of the Hurka tribe; in the fourth year of Tianming he brought his kinsmen and more than a hundred households of his followers to submit; the Taizu sent men to welcome and reward them with a banquet and gifts of furs and robes, slaves, fields and houses, utensils, cattle, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Nahan Tai was headman of the Hurka tribe. In Tianming 4 he brought his kinsmen and more than a hundred households to submit. Taizu sent men to welcome them, feasted them, and granted furs and robes, slaves, fields and houses, utensils, cattle, and horses.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲正紅旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 尋授納罕泰扎爾固齊，托克雅牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Soon Nahan Tai was appointed jarhuci and Tokoya niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Nahan Tai was made jarhuci and Tokoya niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，遷巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he was transferred to bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he was transferred to bayara jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，入自龍井關，遇明三屯營邏卒，斬五人，獲馬七。

translations.literal: He followed a campaign against Ming, entering by Longjing Pass; he met Ming border patrols from the Santun Camp, beheaded five men, and took seven horses.
translations.idiomatic: He joined a campaign against Ming, entering by Longjing Pass, where he met border patrols from the Santun Camp, killed five men, and captured seven horses.

sentences.zh: 護糧以行，明兵來劫，复斬數人，獲纛一。

translations.literal: Escorting grain on the march, when Ming troops came to raid he again beheaded several men and captured one banner.
translations.idiomatic: While escorting grain on the march, he fought off a Ming raid, killed several men, and captured a banner.

sentences.zh: 遂與大軍會，從克遵化。

translations.literal: He then joined the main army and followed in the capture of Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the main army and took part in capturing Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，與甲喇額真榜素等將百人略錦州。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, together with jalan ejen Baysu and others he led a hundred men on a raid against Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year he led a hundred men with jalan ejen Baysu and others on a raid against Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，圍大凌河城，移屯斷錦州、松山道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he besieged Greater Linghe city and shifted camp to cut the routes between Jinzhou and Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he besieged Greater Linghe and shifted camp to block the routes between Jinzhou and Songshan.

sentences.zh: 明兵自錦州至，擊卻之，逐至城下，俘馘甚眾。

translations.literal: When Ming troops came from Jinzhou he attacked and drove them off, pursued them to the city walls, and killed and captured a great many.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming troops came from Jinzhou he drove them off, pursued them to the walls, and killed and captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，攻大同，歸還出尚方堡，察哈爾諸宰桑來歸，上命托克雅率師護降人以還。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed a campaign against Ming and attacked Datong; on the return he went out by Shangfangbao; when the Chahar zaisang came to submit the emperor ordered Tokoya to lead troops to escort the surrendered people back.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the campaign against Ming and attacked Datong. On the return march he exited by Shangfangbao; when Chahar zaisang came to submit, the emperor ordered Tokoya to escort the surrendered people back.

sentences.zh: 敘功，授甲喇章京世職。

translations.literal: His merits were recorded and he was granted the hereditary office of jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: His merits were recognized and he received the hereditary rank of jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 九年，戰於寧遠，與阿濟拜等敗敵。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he fought at Ningyuan and, together with Ajibai and others, defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he fought at Ningyuan and, with Ajibai and others, defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 語詳阿濟拜傳。

translations.literal: The account appears in Ajibai's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account appears in Ajibai's biography.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年八月，從貝勒岳託伐明，越明都，趨山東，圍臨邑，托克雅以雲梯攻克其城，賚馬及白金。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Chongde he followed Beile Yoto in a campaign against Ming, passed beyond the Ming capital, pressed into Shandong, and besieged Linyi; Tokoya took the city by escalade and was rewarded with horses and white silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Chongde 3 he followed Beile Yoto against Ming, passed beyond the capital, pressed into Shandong, and besieged Linyi. Tokoya took the city by escalade and was rewarded with horses and silver.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，擢正紅旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was promoted to meile ejen of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was promoted to meile ejen of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍錦州，與明總督洪承疇戰，當敵砲，被數創。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed in the siege of Jinzhou and fought Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou; he stood in the path of enemy cannon fire and received several wounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the siege of Jinzhou and fought Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou, standing in the path of enemy cannon fire and taking several wounds.

sentences.zh: 七年，解梅勒額真任。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was relieved of the post of meile ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was relieved of the post of meile ejen.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，起為陵寢總管。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he was recalled to serve as mausoleum superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he was recalled to serve as mausoleum superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，卒，年六十有三。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year he died, aged sixty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth month of the second year, aged sixty-three.

sentences.zh: 葉臣，完顏氏，世居兆佳。

translations.literal: Ye Chen—Ye Chen, of the Wanyan clan, originally from Zhaojia.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Chen was of the Wanyan clan and originally from Zhaojia.

sentences.zh: 歸太祖。

translations.literal: He submitted to the Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲鑲紅旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，從伐明，攻鐵嶺，蒙古兵助守拒戰，奮擊破之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianming he followed a campaign against Ming and attacked Tieling; Mongol troops assisted in the defense and resisted; he fought fiercely and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4 he joined the campaign against Ming and attacked Tieling. Mongol troops helped defend the city; he fought fiercely and broke them.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從伐明，克遼陽，以功授游擊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed a campaign against Ming, captured Liaoyang, and for merit was appointed brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again joined the campaign against Ming, captured Liaoyang, and for his service was made brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，各旗置調遣大臣二，葉臣佐鑲紅旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, two dispatch ministers were appointed in each banner; Ye Chen assisted the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, each banner received two dispatch ministers, and Ye Chen was assigned to the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，從貝勒阿敏伐朝鮮，以六十人闌入明邊，俘邏卒六。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong he followed Beile Amin in a campaign against Korea; with sixty men he forced his way into the Ming border and captured six border patrol soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 he followed Beile Amin against Korea. With sixty men he broke into the Ming border and captured six border patrol soldiers.

sentences.zh: 攻義州，與牛錄額真艾博先登，以功授二等參將。

translations.literal: In the attack on Uiju he led the escalade together with niru ejen Aibao and for merit was appointed second-class colonel.
translations.idiomatic: At the attack on Uiju he led the escalade with niru ejen Aibao and for his service was made second-class colonel.

sentences.zh: 率兵戍蒙古，捕斬逋逃，進三等副將。

translations.literal: He led troops to garrison Mongolia, captured and beheaded fugitives, and was advanced to third-class brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: He garrisoned Mongolia, captured and killed fugitives, and was promoted to third-class brigade general.

sentences.zh: 四年，從太宗伐明，攻永平，上命葉臣與副將阿山選部下壯士二十四人，樹雲梯先登。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Taizong in a campaign against Ming and attacked Yongping; the emperor ordered Ye Chen and brigade general Ashan to select twenty-four stalwart men from their followers, raise scaling ladders, and lead the escalade.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed Taizong against Ming and attacked Yongping. The emperor ordered Ye Chen and brigade general Ashan to choose twenty-four stalwart men from their followers, raise scaling ladders, and lead the escalade.

sentences.zh: 語詳阿山傳。

translations.literal: The account appears in Ashan's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account appears in Ashan's biography.

sentences.zh: 城既克，上嘉嘆，且諭諸將曰：「他​​日復攻城，毋令先登。

translations.literal: Once the city was taken, the emperor expressed admiration and moreover instructed the generals: "In days to come, when you again assault cities, do not let them lead the escalade.
translations.idiomatic: Once the city fell, the emperor expressed admiration and told the generals: "When you assault cities hereafter, do not let them lead the escalade.

sentences.zh: 驍將，當共惜之！」

translations.literal: Such fierce generals must be treasured by all!"
translations.idiomatic: Such fierce generals must be treasured by all!"

sentences.zh: 進三等總兵官，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: He was advanced to third-rank commander-in-chief and appointed deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to third-rank commander-in-chief and appointed deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 諭以政有闕​​失，當盡言，葉臣對曰：「臣受恩重，原罄所知入告，但恐臣識未逮耳。」

translations.literal: He was instructed that where governance had omissions and errors he should speak fully; Ye Chen replied: "Your servant has received heavy favor and am willing to report all I know, but I fear my understanding may not reach far enough."
translations.idiomatic: He was told to speak freely about any failings of governance. Ye Chen replied: "Your servant has received great favor and will gladly report all I know, but I fear my understanding may fall short.

sentences.zh: 五年，授鑲紅旗固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed gushan ejen of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed gushan ejen of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，圍大凌河城，葉臣以所部當城西迤南。

translations.literal: Following a campaign against Ming, they besieged Greater Linghe city; Ye Chen placed his division facing the southwest of the city.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Ming and besieged Greater Linghe. Ye Chen posted his division on the southwest of the city.

sentences.zh: 城兵出劘我壘，葉臣與額駙和碩圖等督兵夾擊，殲敵過半。

translations.literal: City troops came out and attacked our encampments; Ye Chen, together with the imperial son-in-law Heshu Tu and others, directed troops in a pincer attack and annihilated more than half the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison sallied against their camps, Ye Chen and the imperial son-in-law Heshu Tu directed a pincer attack and cut down more than half the enemy.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，上命諸貝勒大臣陳時政，時有議直擊山海關者，葉臣疏言：「今我師方聚，宜先往大同、宣府覘察哈爾踪跡，近則攻之；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year the emperor ordered the princes and great ministers to set forth current policies of state; at the time there were those who proposed striking directly at Shanhaiguan; Ye Chen memorialized: "Our armies are now massed; we should first go to Datong and Xuanfu to reconnoiter Chahar movements; if near, attack them;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year the emperor ordered the princes and ministers to report on current affairs. Some proposed striking straight at Shanhaiguan. Ye Chen memorialized: "Our armies are now massed. We should first go to Datong and Xuanfu to scout Chahar movements; if they are near, attack them;

sentences.zh: 若遠，即入明邊，進逼明都。

translations.literal: if far, then enter the Ming border and press toward the Ming capital.
translations.idiomatic: if they are far, enter Ming territory and press toward the Ming capital.

sentences.zh: 伐木為梯，晝夜環攻，即不遽克，亦足以威敵。」

translations.literal: Cut wood for ladders, attack in encirclement day and night; even if we do not take it quickly, it will still be enough to awe the enemy."
translations.idiomatic: Cut ladders from timber and besiege the city day and night—even if we do not take it at once, that alone will overawe the enemy.

sentences.zh: 上韙其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 是月，從貝勒岳託、德格類等攻明旅順口，斬獲無算。

translations.literal: That month he followed Beile Yoto, Degelai, and others in an attack on the Ming position at Lüshunkou; beheadings and captures were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: That month he joined Beile Yoto, Degelai, and others in attacking the Ming position at Lüshunkou, with countless kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 八年，從貝勒代善自喀拉鄂博入得勝堡，略大同，西至黃河，擊敗明朔州騎兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Beile Daishan from Kala'ebo into Desheng Fort, raided Datong, went west as far as the Yellow River, and defeated Ming cavalry from Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed Beile Daishan from Kala'ebo through Desheng Fort, raided Datong, pushed west to the Yellow River, and defeated Ming cavalry from Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年五月，從武英郡王阿濟格等伐明，既入邊，分兵下安州；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying and others in a campaign against Ming; after entering the border, troops were divided to take Anzhou;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying against Ming. After crossing the border, detachments were sent to take Anzhou;

sentences.zh: 又合攻寶坻，穴其城，克之。

translations.literal: they combined to attack Baodi, mined the city wall, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: then the forces combined to attack Baodi, undermined the wall, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 十二月，從上伐朝鮮，與諸固山額真率阿禮哈超哈兵入其王都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he followed the emperor in a campaign against Korea; together with the various gushan ejen he led light cavalry into the Korean capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he followed the emperor against Korea and, with the other gushan ejen, led light cavalry into the royal capital.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，從阿濟格攻明皮島，與阿山督白奇超哈兵乘小舟攻島西北隅，麾兵先進，斬明總兵沈世奎，島下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year he followed Ajige in an attack on Ming Pik Island; together with Ashan he directed white-banded light cavalry in small boats to attack the northwest corner of the island, waved his troops forward, beheaded Ming regional commander Shen Shikui, and the island fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Chongde 2 he followed Ajige against Ming Pik Island. With Ashan he directed white-banded light cavalry in small boats against the northwest of the island, drove his men forward, killed Ming regional commander Shen Shikui, and the island fell.

sentences.zh: 師還，進一等總兵官。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was advanced to first-rank commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was promoted to first-rank commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 四年，從貝勒岳託等伐明，入青山口，略太平寨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Beile Yoto and others in a campaign against Ming, entered by Qingshan Pass, and raided Taiping Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he joined Beile Yoto and others against Ming, entered by Qingshan Pass, and raided Taiping Fort.

sentences.zh: 岳託令每旗遣梅勒章京一，每牛錄簡甲士三，使葉臣與固山額真譚泰為將，攻克其關，遇敵十三戰皆勝，得馬六十。

translations.literal: Yoto ordered each banner to send one meiren janggin and each niru to select three armored soldiers; Ye Chen and gushan ejen Tan Tai were made generals, captured the pass, fought the enemy in thirteen battles and won them all, and obtained sixty horses.
translations.idiomatic: Yoto ordered each banner to send one meiren janggin and each niru to provide three armored soldiers; Ye Chen and gushan ejen Tan Tai were made generals, took the pass, fought thirteen engagements without defeat, and seized sixty horses.

sentences.zh: 七年，命代貝勒阿巴泰戍錦州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to replace Beile Abatai in garrisoning Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was ordered to replace Beile Abatai as garrison commander at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，率師徇山西。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in the entry through the passes and led troops to pacify Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed the passes into China and led troops to pacify Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 師所經行，自直隸饒陽至河南懷慶，傍近諸府縣悉下，進克太原。

translations.literal: Where the army passed—from Raoyang in Zhili to Huaiqing in Henan—all neighboring prefectures and counties were taken, and they advanced to capture Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: From Raoyang in Zhili to Huaiqing in Henan, every prefecture and county along the route fell; the army then advanced and captured Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 先後定府九、州二十七、縣一百四十一，署置官吏，安輯居民。

translations.literal: In succession they secured nine prefectures, twenty-seven subprefectures, and a hundred forty-one counties, appointed provisional officials, and settled the inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: They secured nine prefectures, twenty-seven departments, and a hundred forty-one counties, appointed provisional officials, and restored order among the people.

sentences.zh: 明將李際遇屯河南境，依山為寨。

translations.literal: Ming general Li Jiyu encamped in Henan territory, building a stockade against the hills.
translations.idiomatic: Ming general Li Jiyu held a hill fort in Henan.

sentences.zh: 唐通、董學禮降李自成，擁眾擾邊。

translations.literal: Tang Tong and Dong Xueli had submitted to Li Zicheng and led crowds to harass the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Tong and Dong Xueli had surrendered to Li Zicheng and now led bands raiding the borders.

sentences.zh: 葉臣皆招使來降，山西底定。

translations.literal: Ye Chen summoned them all to come and submit; Shanxi was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Chen won them all over to submission, and Shanxi was settled.

sentences.zh: 師還，至定州，土寇有自號掃地王者，糾徒黨剽掠，葉臣遣兵討平之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, reaching Dingzhou, local bandits styling themselves "King Who Sweeps the Earth" gathered followers to plunder; Ye Chen sent troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march at Dingzhou, local bandits calling themselves "King Who Sweeps the Earth" gathered followers to raid; Ye Chen sent troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 比至京，坐擅毀禁垣，屏其功不錄，但賜白金六百。

translations.literal: By the time he reached the capital he was punished for arbitrarily destroying forbidden walls; his merits were set aside and unrecorded, and he was only granted six hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the capital he was punished for unlawfully tearing down forbidden walls; his achievements went unrecorded and he received only six hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 二年，豫親王多鐸定江南。

translations.literal: In the second year Prince Dodo of Yu settled Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Prince Dodo of Yu pacified Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 七月，命貝勒勒克德渾為平南大將軍，以葉臣佐之，代多鐸鎮撫；

translations.literal: In the seventh month Beile Lekedehun was appointed Pacifying-the-South Grand General with Ye Chen to assist him, replacing Dodo in garrisoning and pacifying;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Beile Lekedehun was appointed Pacifying-the-South Grand General, with Ye Chen as his second, to replace Dodo in governing the south;

sentences.zh: 並命大學士洪承疇招撫南方諸行省，敕滿洲諸軍會葉臣調遣，有不順命者，葉臣發兵搜捕，輒奏績。

translations.literal: the Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou was also ordered to win over the southern provinces; Manchu armies were instructed to assemble under Ye Chen's dispatch; whenever anyone disobeyed orders, Ye Chen sent troops to search and seize them and promptly reported achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou was also charged with winning over the southern provinces. Manchu armies were ordered to report to Ye Chen for deployment; whenever anyone resisted, Ye Chen sent troops to hunt them down and promptly reported success.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以自成餘黨一隻虎等出沒武昌、襄陽、荊州諸府，命葉臣從勒克德渾移師剿除。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because the remnant bands of Zicheng such as One-Eyed Tiger were appearing in Wuchang, Xiangyang, Jingzhou, and other prefectures, Ye Chen was ordered to follow Lekedehun in transferring troops to suppress and eliminate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, with Li Zicheng's remnant lieutenant One-Eyed Tiger and others raiding Wuchang, Xiangyang, Jingzhou, and neighboring prefectures, Ye Chen was ordered to join Lekedehun in moving troops to wipe them out.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，師還，賜黃金三十、白金五百。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year the army returned; he was granted thirty taels of gold and five hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year the army returned. He was granted thirty taels of gold and five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 四年，改一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was changed to first-class jingqi nihafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was reclassified as first-class jingqi nihafan.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died.

sentences.zh: 是年七月，定封二等精奇尼哈番，以長子車爾布襲；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year the rank was fixed at second-class jingqi nihafan, inherited by his eldest son Cheerbu;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year the rank was fixed as second-class jingqi nihafan and inherited by his eldest son Cheerbu;

sentences.zh: 复兼一拖沙喇哈番，以第五子車赫圖襲。

translations.literal: and again a tuosalaha hafan was added, inherited by his fifth son Che Hetu.
translations.idiomatic: a tuosalaha hafan was also added, inherited by his fifth son Che Hetu.

sentences.zh: 車爾布初官甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Cheerbu's first post was jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Cheerbu's first appointment was jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年，從攻錦州，與諸將共為伏，破明兵，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongde he followed in the attack on Jinzhou; together with other generals he lay in ambush, broke Ming troops, and was promoted to bayara da janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 6 he joined the attack on Jinzhou. Lying in ambush with other commanders, he routed Ming forces and was promoted to bayara da janggin.

sentences.zh: 從入關，擊李自成，追及於安肅，复追及於慶都，殲賊甚眾，授世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: Following the entry through the passes he attacked Li Zicheng, caught up with him at Ansu, caught up again at Qingdu, annihilated great numbers of rebels, and was granted the hereditary office of baitalablu hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the passes and fought Li Zicheng, overtook him at Ansu and again at Qingdu, killed large numbers of rebels, and received the hereditary rank of baitalablu hafan.

sentences.zh: 既，復從英親王阿濟格西討自成，師出塞，道土默特、鄂爾多斯；

translations.literal: Afterward he again followed Prince Ajige of Ying in a western expedition against Zicheng; the army left the frontier, passing through Tumed and Ordos;
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Prince Ajige of Ying on the western campaign against Li Zicheng. The army left the frontier and marched through Tumed and Ordos;

sentences.zh: 入塞渡黃河，鑿冰以濟。

translations.literal: reentered the frontier, crossed the Yellow River, and broke ice to ford it.
translations.idiomatic: reentered China, crossed the Yellow River, and broke through the ice to ford it.

sentences.zh: 順治二年春，師至榆林，賊夜襲蒙古軍，車爾布與牛錄額真蘇拜往援，破敵，還軍遇伏，复縱擊卻之，與固山額真伊拜拊循旁近諸府縣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Shunzhi the army reached Yulin; rebels attacked the Mongol army by night; Cheerbu and niru ejen Subai went to their relief and broke the enemy; on the return march they met ambush and again pressed the attack and drove them back; together with gushan ejen Ibai he pacified the neighboring prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Shunzhi 2 the army reached Yulin. Rebels attacked the Mongol forces by night; Cheerbu and niru ejen Subai went to their aid and routed them. On the march back they met an ambush; Cheerbu attacked again and beat it back. With gushan ejen Ibai he then pacified the surrounding prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 師進圍延安，與梅勒額真羅璧戰敗城兵。

translations.literal: The army advanced to besiege Yan'an; together with meiren ejen Luobi he fought and defeated the city troops.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced to besiege Yan'an. With meiren ejen Luobi he defeated the garrison in battle.

sentences.zh: 自成走湖廣，車爾布與巴牙喇纛章京鰲拜以師從之，攻安陸，得舟八十；

translations.literal: Zicheng fled to Huguang; Cheerbu and bayara da janggin Oboi followed with the army, attacked Anlu, and obtained eighty boats;
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng fled to Huguang. Cheerbu and bayara da janggin Oboi pursued with their troops, attacked Anlu, and captured eighty boats;

sentences.zh: 復與巴牙喇甲喇章京噶達渾逐賊九宮山，敗其騎兵，自成死。

translations.literal: again with bayara jalan janggin Gadahun he pursued the rebels to Jiugong Mountain, defeated their cavalry, and Zicheng died.
translations.idiomatic: With bayara jalan janggin Gadahun he pursued the rebels to Jiugong Mountain, routed their cavalry, and Li Zicheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 師還，授議政大臣，加一拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was appointed deliberative minister and granted an additional tuosalaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was made deliberative minister and granted an additional tuosalaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格討張獻忠，屢戰皆捷，與貝勒尼堪等徇遵義、夔州諸府縣。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Hooge of Su in suppressing Zhang Xianzhong; in repeated battles he always won; together with Beile Nikan and others he pacified Zunyi, Kuizhou, and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Prince Hooge of Su against Zhang Xianzhong and won repeated victories. With Beile Nikan and others he pacified Zunyi, Kuizhou, and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 尋以巴牙喇纛章京哈寧阿被圍，車爾布未及援，降拖沙喇哈番，輟其賞及既襲父爵。

translations.literal: Soon after, because bayara da janggin Haning'a was besieged and Cheerbu failed to arrive in time to relieve him, his tuosalaha hafan was reduced; his reward and his recently inherited father's rank were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, bayara da janggin Haning'a was besieged and Cheerbu failed to relieve him in time. His tuosalaha hafan was reduced and his reward and newly inherited father's rank were withheld.

sentences.zh: 六年，姜瓖以大同叛，車爾布從英親王阿濟格帥師討之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Jiang Xiang rebelled at Datong; Cheerbu followed Prince Ajige of Ying in leading troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Jiang Xiang rebelled at Datong. Cheerbu joined Prince Ajige of Ying in leading troops against him.

sentences.zh: 瓖出攻鑲紅旗營，車爾布率巴牙喇兵御之，瓖敗走。

translations.literal: Xiang came out to attack the Bordered Red Banner camp; Cheerbu led bayara troops to repel him and Xiang was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Xiang attacked the Bordered Red Banner camp; Cheerbu led bayara troops to repel him and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 瓖黨自阻馬、得勝二路分兵循北山逼我軍，瓖復以城兵出戰，鰲拜率先當賊，車爾布與梅勒額真譚布合兵繼進，遂殲瓖兵。

translations.literal: Xiang's partisans split forces along the Zuma and Desheng routes, following the northern hills to press our army; Xiang again led city troops out to fight; Oboi took the lead to meet the enemy; Cheerbu and meiren ejen Tanbu combined forces and advanced behind him, and Xiang's troops were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Xiang's followers split along the Zuma and Desheng routes to press the army from the northern hills. Jiang Xiang sallied again with city troops; Oboi engaged the enemy first; Cheerbu and meiren ejen Tanbu followed with combined forces and annihilated Jiang Xiang's army.

sentences.zh: 兩遇恩詔，累進三等伯。

translations.literal: On two benevolent amnesties he was repeatedly advanced to third-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: On two benevolent amnesties he was repeatedly promoted to third-rank count.

sentences.zh: 十二年十二月，命與寧海大將軍伊爾德率師徇浙江，擊斬明魯王將王長樹、王光祚、沈爾序等。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year he was ordered together with Pacifying-the-Sea Grand General Ird to lead troops to pacify Zhejiang, striking down and beheading Ming Prince of Lu's generals Wang Changshu, Wang Guangzuo, Shen Erxu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Shunzhi 12 he was ordered with Pacifying-the-Sea Grand General Ird to pacify Zhejiang, killing Ming Prince of Lu's generals Wang Changshu, Wang Guangzuo, Shen Erxu, and others.

sentences.zh: 與伊爾德自寧波航定海，分三路進攻，敵萬餘，列舟二百，戰敗；

translations.literal: With Ird he sailed from Ningbo to Dinghai, divided into three routes to attack; the enemy numbered over ten thousand and lined up two hundred boats; they were defeated in battle;
translations.idiomatic: With Ird he sailed from Ningbo to Dinghai and attacked in three columns. The enemy mustered more than ten thousand men and two hundred boats and were defeated;

sentences.zh: 逐之，至衡水洋，斬思、六禦，獲其將林德等百餘人，遂克舟山。

translations.literal: pursuing them to Hengshui Bay, beheading Si and Liuyu, capturing their generals Lin De and more than a hundred others, and then capturing Zhoushan.
translations.idiomatic: pursued them to Hengshui Bay, killed Si and Liuyu, captured generals including Lin De and more than a hundred others, and took Zhoushan.

sentences.zh: 語互見伊爾德傳。

translations.literal: The account is also given in the biography of Ird.
translations.idiomatic: See also the biography of Ird.

sentences.zh: 以功進一等伯，兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to first-rank count and additionally granted tuosalaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was promoted to first-rank count and additionally granted tuosalaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 十五年十二月，命與安南將軍明安達理戍貴州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifteenth year he was ordered together with Pacifying-Annan General Ming'andali to garrison Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Shunzhi 15 he was ordered with Pacifying-Annan General Ming'andali to garrison Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月，復命移駐荊州。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixteenth year he was again ordered to transfer and garrison at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 16 he was ordered to move his garrison to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，鄭成功入攻江寧，車爾布與明安達理自荊州赴援，循江而下，擊敗成功將楊文英，斬其裨將，獲舟及諸攻具。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Zheng Chenggong entered and attacked Jiangning; Cheerbu and Ming'andali came from Jingzhou to relieve the city, proceeding downriver, defeated Chenggong's general Yang Wenying, beheaded his lieutenant general, and captured boats and all siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zheng Chenggong attacked Jiangning. Cheerbu and Ming'andali marched from Jingzhou downriver, defeated Chenggong's general Yang Wenying, killed his lieutenant, and captured boats and siege equipment.

sentences.zh: 十七年十一月，師還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Shunzhi 17 the army returned.

sentences.zh: 十八年，改鑲紅旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was changed to commander of the Mongol division of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 he was made commander of the Mongol division of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，以久疾解都統，降三等伯。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, because of long illness he was relieved of the commander's post and reduced to third-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3, after a long illness he was relieved as commander and reduced to third-rank count.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third month of Kangxi 7.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年，定封號曰威靖。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong the enfeoffment title was fixed as Weijing.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 the fief title was fixed as Weijing.

sentences.zh: 初，從葉臣攻永平，先登凡二十四人，蘇魯邁其一也。

translations.literal: At the beginning, in following Ye Chen to attack Yongping, those who scaled the walls first numbered twenty-four in all; Surumai was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: When Ye Chen attacked Yongping, twenty-four men led the escalade; Surumai was among them.

sentences.zh: 蘇魯邁，嵩佳氏，滿洲正藍旗人，世居棟鄂部。

translations.literal: Surumai, of the Songjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner, originally from the Dong'e tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Surumai was of the Songjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner, originally from the Dong'e tribe.

sentences.zh: 父遜札哩，歸太祖，太祖錄其長子蘇巴海，授牛錄章京。

translations.literal: His father Sunzhali submitted to Taizu; Taizu registered his eldest son Subahai and appointed him niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sunzhali submitted to Taizu, who registered his eldest son Subahai and appointed him niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 天命三年，蘇魯邁從伐明，攻撫順，樹雲梯先登。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianming Surumai followed a campaign against Ming and attacked Fushun; he erected a scaling ladder and was first to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 3 Surumai joined the campaign against Ming and attacked Fushun, raising a scaling ladder and leading the escalade.

sentences.zh: 六年，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 復從伐明，取瀋陽、遼陽。

translations.literal: Again following campaigns against Ming, he took Shenyang and Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined campaigns against Ming and took Shenyang and Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，從阿敏伐朝鮮，攻義州，蘇魯邁以二十人先諸軍登城。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong he followed Amin in a campaign against Korea and attacked Uiju; Surumai with twenty men scaled the wall before the rest of the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 he followed Amin against Korea and attacked Uiju. Surumai and twenty men scaled the wall ahead of the main force.

sentences.zh: 三年，從太宗伐明，攻克洪山口城。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Taizong in a campaign against Ming and captured Hongshankou city.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he followed Taizong against Ming and captured Hongshankou.

sentences.zh: 予世職備禦。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary office of defense commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He received the hereditary rank of defense commandant.

sentences.zh: 其從葉臣攻永平也，城上火器發，蘇魯邁面中槍，不退；

translations.literal: When he followed Ye Chen to attack Yongping, fire weapons on the wall were discharged; Surumai was struck in the face by a musket ball but did not retreat;
translations.idiomatic: When he followed Ye Chen against Yongping, firearms blazed from the wall. Surumai took a musket ball in the face but did not retreat;

sentences.zh: 敵砲裂自焚，冒火援雲梯上，城遂下。

translations.literal: the enemy's cannon exploded and burned of itself; he braved the fire, climbed the scaling ladder, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: An enemy cannon burst and caught fire; he braved the flames, climbed the scaling ladder, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 上遣醫視創，賜號「巴圖魯」，賚牲畜、布帛，進世職游擊。

translations.literal: The emperor sent a physician to treat his wound, granted him the title "Baturu," bestowed livestock and cloth, and advanced his hereditary rank to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent a physician to treat his wounds, granted him the title Baturu, bestowed livestock and cloth, and promoted his hereditary rank to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 復從伐明，取旅順，略寧遠，戰必先眾，恆以被創受賞。

translations.literal: Again following campaigns against Ming, he took Lüshun, raided Ningyuan, always fought ahead of the multitude, and constantly received rewards for being wounded.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined campaigns against Ming, took Lüshun, raided Ningyuan, always fought at the fore, and was repeatedly rewarded for wounds taken in battle.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，將入邊，攻鵰鶚城，砲傷口，因以殘疾家居。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying in a campaign against Ming; as they were about to enter the border they attacked Diao'e Fort; a cannon wounded his mouth, and because of this disability he lived at home.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying against Ming. As the army was about to cross the border he attacked Diao'e Fort; a cannon wound to the mouth left him disabled, and he retired to his home.

sentences.zh: 順治間，恩詔，累進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the Shunzhi period, on benevolent amnesties he was repeatedly advanced to third-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, under benevolent amnesties he was repeatedly promoted to third-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年十一月，卒，諡勤勇。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Kangxi he died; his posthumous title was Qinyong.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eleventh month of Kangxi 1 and was posthumously titled Qinyong.

sentences.zh: 蘇魯邁子蘇爾濟、遜哈、三塔哈、鄂洛順、翁鄂洛。

translations.literal: Surumai's sons were Surji, Sunha, Santaha, Oeloshun, and Ong'eoluo.
translations.idiomatic: Surumai's sons were Surji, Sunha, Santaha, Oeloshun, and Ong'eoluo.

sentences.zh: 蘇爾濟，順治初以噶布什賢轄從入關，與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦錫特庫擊敗李自成將唐通於一片石。

translations.literal: Surji, at the beginning of Shunzhi, followed in the entry through the passes as a member of the Gabsihiyan guard, and together with Gabsihiyan Gala'i Angbang Sitku defeated Li Zicheng's general Tang Tong at Yipianshi.
translations.idiomatic: Surji entered the passes at the start of Shunzhi as a member of the Gabsihiyan guard and, with Gabsihiyan Gala'i Angbang Sitku, defeated Li Zicheng's general Tang Tong at Yipianshi.

sentences.zh: 三年，從端重親王博洛徇福建，敗明將薑正希於汀州，予世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Boluo of Duanzhong in pacifying Fujian, defeated Ming general Jiang Zhengxi at Tingzhou, and was granted the hereditary office of baitalablu hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Prince Boluo of Duanzhong in pacifying Fujian, defeated Ming general Jiang Zhengxi at Tingzhou, and received the hereditary rank of baitalablu hafan.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he died.

sentences.zh: 鄂洛順，事聖祖。

translations.literal: Oeloshun served Shengzu.
translations.idiomatic: Oeloshun served Shengzu.

sentences.zh: 以二等護衛從建威將軍佛尼埒討吳三桂，敗其將高定；

translations.literal: As a second-class guard he followed Establishing-Might General Fenile in suppressing Wu Sangui and defeated his general Gao Ding;
translations.idiomatic: As a second-class guard he followed Establishing-Might General Fenile against Wu Sangui and defeated his general Gao Ding;

sentences.zh: 以前鋒統領從裕親王福全擊噶爾丹。

translations.literal: as vanguard commander he followed Prince Fuquan of Yu in attacking Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: as vanguard commander he followed Prince Fuquan of Yu against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 有功，累遷江寧將軍。

translations.literal: For merit he was repeatedly transferred until he became general of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he rose through the ranks to become general of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 翁鄂洛，事聖祖。

translations.literal: Ong'eoluo served Shengzu.
translations.idiomatic: Ong'eoluo served Shengzu.

sentences.zh: 從征南大將軍賚塔討吳世璠，師自廣西入，戰石門坎，敗其將何繼祖；

translations.literal: Following Campaigning-South Grand General Laita in suppressing Wu Shifan, the army entered from Guangxi, fought at Shimenkan, and defeated his general He Jizu;
translations.idiomatic: Following Campaigning-South Grand General Laita against Wu Shifan, the army entered from Guangxi, fought at Shimenkan, and defeated his general He Jizu;

sentences.zh: 再戰黃草壩，复敗繼祖，獲詹養、王有功。

translations.literal: fighting again at Huangcao Dam, again defeated Jizu, and captured Zhan Yang and Wang Yougong.
translations.idiomatic: fighting again at Huangcao Dam, defeated He Jizu again, and captured Zhan Yang and Wang Yougong.

sentences.zh: 薄雲南，殲胡國柄，逐捕馬寶、巴養元等。

translations.literal: Pressing toward Yunnan, they annihilated Hu Guobing and pursued and captured Ma Bao, Ba Yangyuan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing toward Yunnan, they killed Hu Guobing and pursued Ma Bao, Ba Yangyuan, and others.

sentences.zh: 以功進三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to third-class adahahafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was promoted to third-class adahahafan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 珠瑪喇，碧魯氏，世居葉赫。

translations.literal: Zhu Ma La—Zhu Ma La, of the Bilu clan, originally from Yehe.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ma La was of the Bilu clan and originally from Yehe.

sentences.zh: 太祖時，率所部虎爾哈人來歸。

translations.literal: In the time of Taizu he led his followers of the Hurka people to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Taizu's time he led his Hurka followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲鑲白旗，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered White Banner and appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Bordered White Banner and appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從伐明，次遵化，擊敗明兵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he followed a campaign against Ming, halted at Zunhua, and defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he joined the campaign against Ming, halted at Zunhua, and defeated Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 後三日，太宗臨視遵化，明兵自山海關至，將入城，珠瑪喇以邏卒十人御之，所擊殺甚眾。

translations.literal: Three days later Taizong came in person to inspect Zunhua; Ming troops arrived from Shanhaiguan and were about to enter the city; Zhu Ma La with ten border patrol soldiers repelled them and killed a great many in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later Taizong came in person to inspect Zunhua. Ming troops marched from Shanhaiguan and were about to enter the city; Zhu Ma La and ten border patrol soldiers held them off and killed a great many.

sentences.zh: 薄明都，遇明總兵滿桂、黑雲龍、麻登雲、孫祖壽諸軍入大紅門，與額駙揚古利、甲喇額真音達戶齊擊之明兵左次，旋克永平。

translations.literal: Pressing toward the Ming capital, they encountered Ming regional commanders Man Gui, Hei Yunlong, Ma Dengyun, Sun Zushou, and their armies entering the Great Red Gate; together with imperial son-in-law Yang Guli and jiala ejen Yindahu they jointly struck the Ming army's left wing, and soon took Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing toward the Ming capital, they met Ming regional commanders Man Gui, Hei Yunlong, Ma Dengyun, and Sun Zushou with their armies at the Great Red Gate. Together with imperial son-in-law Yang Guli and jiala ejen Yindahu, they struck the Ming left wing and soon captured Yongping.

sentences.zh: 復攻昌黎，先登，被六創。

translations.literal: Again they attacked Changli; he was first to scale the wall and received six wounds.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Changli again; he was first over the wall and took six wounds.

sentences.zh: 以功授備禦。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted the post of guard captain.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was made guard captain.

sentences.zh: 尋坐事奪世職。

translations.literal: Soon for an offense he was stripped of his hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was stripped of his hereditary rank for an offense.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍大凌河城，明監軍道張春赴援，珠瑪喇與甲喇額真鄂諾迭戰，破其前鋒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Greater Linghe city; Ming supervising secretary Zhang Chun came to relieve it; Zhu Ma La fought with jiala ejen Enuoe and broke their vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Greater Linghe. When Ming supervising secretary Zhang Chun came to relieve the city, Zhu Ma La fought jiala ejen Enuoe and broke the Ming vanguard.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐察哈爾，次穆魯哈岱，獲布延圖台吉，殲其從者百餘，俘其孥。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined a campaign against the Chahar, halting at Murkhadai; they took Buyantu taiji, slaughtered over a hundred of his followers, and captured his family.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against the Chahar and halted at Murkhadai. They captured Buyantu taiji, killed more than a hundred of his followers, and took his family prisoner.

sentences.zh: 七年，從貝勒德格類、岳託攻旅順口，將巴牙喇兵十人，以舟登擊甕城。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Princes Degelai and Yoto in attacking Lüshunkou, leading ten bayara soldiers to board boats and assault the barbican.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Princes Degelai and Yoto in the attack on Lüshunkou, leading ten bayara soldiers in boats against the barbican.

sentences.zh: 巴奇蘭既令於眾，珠瑪喇與牛錄額真雍舜超躍而上，大聲自名曰：「珠瑪喇登城矣！」

translations.literal: After Baqilan had given the order to the host, Zhu Ma La and niru ejen Yong Shun leaped up; he cried his own name aloud: "Zhu Ma La has scaled the wall!"
translations.idiomatic: After Baqilan had given the order, Zhu Ma La and niru ejen Yong Shun leaped up the wall. He shouted his own name: "Zhu Ma La is on the wall!"

sentences.zh: 被三創，不少卻，卒拔其城。

translations.literal: He received three wounds but did not yield in the least, and in the end stormed the city.
translations.idiomatic: He took three wounds but did not give ground, and in the end the city fell.

sentences.zh: 上聞，嘉嘆，親酌金卮以賜，复世職。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he praised him in admiration, personally poured a golden goblet as a gift, and restored his hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard, he praised him warmly, personally poured him a golden goblet, and restored his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 九年，從貝勒多鐸伐明，圍錦州，夜設雲梯以攻，被創甚。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Prince Dorgon in a campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou; scaling ladders were set up by night for the assault, and he was grievously wounded.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Prince Dorgon against Ming and besieged Jinzhou. Scaling ladders were raised by night for the assault, and he was badly wounded.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮，力戰，克山寨；

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he joined a campaign against Korea, fought fiercely, and took fortified mountain villages;
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he joined the campaign against Korea, fought hard, and captured fortified mountain villages;

sentences.zh: 從伐明，敗明總兵，取四縣。

translations.literal: he joined a campaign against Ming, defeated a Ming regional commander, and took four counties.
translations.idiomatic: he joined a campaign against Ming, defeated a Ming regional commander, and took four counties.

sentences.zh: 三年，授兵部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed executive officer of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made executive officer of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: He joined a campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He joined a campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 明兵屯廣寧北苕峙山，珠瑪喇別將四十人破其寨；

translations.literal: Ming troops were encamped at Tiaozhi Mountain north of Guangning; Zhu Ma La with a separate detachment of forty men broke their camp;
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops were encamped at Tiaozhi Mountain north of Guangning; Zhu Ma La with a detached force of forty men stormed their camp;

sentences.zh: 又招降別軍屯駱駝山及大凌河北山諸寨。

translations.literal: and also induced the surrender of separate forces encamped at Luotuo Mountain and the various camps on the northern hills of Greater Linghe.
translations.idiomatic: and also induced separate Ming forces at Luotuo Mountain and the camps on the northern hills of Greater Linghe to surrender.

sentences.zh: 六年，命與甲喇額真僖福監張家口互市。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered together with jiala ejen Xifu to supervise the trading market at Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he and jiala ejen Xifu were ordered to supervise the trading market at Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 事畢，所司劾珠瑪喇以私財為市，且索馬蒙古，論死，上命寬之，复奪世職，輸所市物入官。

translations.literal: When the affair was finished, the responsible offices impeached Zhu Ma La for using private wealth in the market and also extorting horses from Mongols; death was proposed, but the emperor ordered leniency, again stripped his hereditary office, and had the goods traded turned over to the government.
translations.idiomatic: When the market closed, the responsible offices impeached Zhu Ma La for trading with private funds and extorting horses from Mongols. Death was proposed, but the emperor ordered leniency, stripped his hereditary rank again, and had the traded goods turned over to the state.

sentences.zh: 尋從鄭親王濟爾哈朗复圍錦州，敵將奪我軍砲，珠瑪喇擊之退；

translations.literal: Soon afterward he joined Prince Jirhalang of Zheng in again besieging Jinzhou; an enemy commander seized our army's cannon, and Zhu Ma La struck them and drove them back;
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he joined Prince Jirhalang of Zheng in besieging Jinzhou again. When an enemy commander seized Qing cannon, Zhu Ma La attacked and drove him off;

sentences.zh: 既，復至，珠瑪喇射殪敵，敵乃潰。

translations.literal: When they came again, Zhu Ma La shot and killed an enemy officer, and the enemy then broke.
translations.idiomatic: When they returned, Zhu Ma La shot and killed an enemy officer, and the enemy broke.

sentences.zh: 七年，與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦沙爾虎達伐虎爾哈部，降喀爾喀木等十屯，俘壯丁千餘及牲畜、輜重以歸，上命迎勞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, together with Gabsihiyan Gala'i Angbang Sharhuda he campaigned against the Hurka tribes, received the surrender of ten settlements including Karkemu, captured over a thousand strong men along with livestock and baggage on the return; the emperor ordered a welcome reception.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he campaigned against the Hurka tribes with Gabsihiyan Gala'i Angbang Sharhuda, received the surrender of ten settlements including Karkemu, and returned with more than a thousand able-bodied captives along with livestock and baggage. The emperor ordered a formal welcome.

sentences.zh: 順治初，珠瑪喇以甲喇額真從入關，擊李自成。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, Zhu Ma La as jiala ejen followed in the entry through the passes and attacked Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi, Zhu Ma La entered the passes as jiala ejen and attacked Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 尋授正藍旗滿洲梅勒額真、兵部侍郎，复世職。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed meile ejen of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner and vice minister of the Board of War, and his hereditary office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made meile ejen of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner and vice minister of the Board of War, and his hereditary rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月，與梅勒額真和託等帥師駐防杭州，珠瑪喇將左翼。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year, together with meile ejen Hoto and others he led troops to garrison Hangzhou; Zhu Ma La commanded the left wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year he garrisoned Hangzhou with meile ejen Hoto and others; Zhu Ma La commanded the left wing.

sentences.zh: 馬士英、方國安自嚴州侵餘杭，珠瑪喇擊之走。

translations.literal: Ma Shiying and Fang Guo'an invaded Yuhang from Yanzhou; Zhu Ma La struck them and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Shiying and Fang Guo'an invaded Yuhang from Yanzhou, Zhu Ma La attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 還，未至杭州三十里，遇土寇，复擊破之。

translations.literal: On the return, thirty li short of Hangzhou, they met local bandits and again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march, thirty li from Hangzhou, they met local bandits and defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 國安等仍以數万人分屯江東諸山及杭州郊外硃橋、範村諸地，珠瑪喇與總兵田雄、副將張傑等分兵逐捕。

translations.literal: Guo'an and the others still kept tens of thousands of men divided in camps on the hills east of the river and at Zhuhua Bridge, Fancun, and other places outside Hangzhou; Zhu Ma La with regional commander Tian Xiong, deputy commander Zhang Jie, and others divided forces to hunt them down.
translations.idiomatic: Guo'an and the others still held tens of thousands of men in camps on the hills east of the river and at Zhuhua Bridge, Fancun, and other places outside Hangzhou. Zhu Ma La, regional commander Tian Xiong, deputy commander Zhang Jie, and others divided their forces to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 三年，率師徇福建，與巴牙喇纛章京敦拜擊破明兵。

translations.literal: In the third year he led troops into Fujian and, together with bayara da janggin Dunbai, defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he led troops into Fujian and, with bayara da janggin Dunbai, defeated Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 五年，從征南大將軍譚泰討叛將金聲桓於江西，與固山額真何洛會及沙爾虎達等屢敗聲桓兵，焚其舟千三百有奇，下九江及其屬縣凡六。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Pacification General of the South Tan Tai in suppressing the rebel general Jin Shenghuan in Jiangxi; with gushan ejen He Luohui and Sharhuda and others he repeatedly defeated Shenghuan's troops, burned over thirteen hundred of his boats, and took Jiujiang and six subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Pacification General of the South Tan Tai against the rebel general Jin Shenghuan in Jiangxi. With gushan ejen He Luohui, Sharhuda, and others he repeatedly defeated Shenghuan's forces, burned more than thirteen hundred boats, and captured Jiujiang and six subordinate counties.

sentences.zh: 遷正白旗蒙古固山額真、吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain White Banner and minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain White Banner and minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 世職累進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to third-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank was repeatedly promoted to third-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 十年冬，坐選授山東驛道房之麒嘗佔籍青州不詳勘，罷尚書。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth year, because Fang Zhiqi, whom he had selected and appointed as Shandong courier-route intendant, had once held household registration in Qingzhou without thorough investigation, he was dismissed as minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the tenth year he was dismissed as minister because Fang Zhiqi, whom he had appointed Shandong courier-route intendant, had once held household registration in Qingzhou without proper investigation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，明將李定國等寇廣東，命珠瑪喇為靖南將軍，副以敦拜，率師討之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Ming generals Li Dingguo and others raided Guangdong; Zhu Ma La was appointed General for Pacifying the South, with Dunbai as deputy, to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Ming generals Li Dingguo and others raided Guangdong. Zhu Ma La was appointed General for Pacifying the South, with Dunbai as deputy, to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 方攻新會，尚可喜、耿繼茂等軍於三水，扼隘列屯。

translations.literal: While attacking Xinhui, Shang Kexi, Geng Jimao, and others encamped at Sanshui, holding the passes in fortified camps.
translations.idiomatic: While he was attacking Xinhui, Shang Kexi, Geng Jimao, and others encamped at Sanshui, holding the passes in fortified lines.

sentences.zh: 珠瑪喇至，與合軍擊敵，戰於珊洲，斬副將一，獲裨將十餘，馘一百五十餘級。

translations.literal: When Zhu Ma La arrived, he joined their armies to strike the enemy; at Shanzhou they fought, beheaded one deputy commander, captured over ten brigade commanders, and took over a hundred and fifty heads.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Ma La arrived, he joined their armies and attacked the enemy at Shanzhou. They beheaded one deputy commander, captured more than ten brigade commanders, and took over a hundred and fifty heads.

sentences.zh: 師至新會，定國所將步騎卒四萬，分據山險列砲，以像為陣。

translations.literal: When the army reached Xinhui, Dingguo commanded forty thousand infantry and cavalry in all, holding mountain defiles with cannon deployed and using war elephants in formation.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Xinhui, Dingguo commanded forty thousand infantry and cavalry, holding mountain defiles with cannon and deploying war elephants in formation.

sentences.zh: 珠瑪喇督將士力戰，定國兵既卻，復出兵四千餘人自山上馳下，我師力禦敗之，奪其山，定國兵乃遁。

translations.literal: Zhu Ma La roused the officers and men to fight fiercely; after Dingguo's troops had retreated, over four thousand men again rushed down from the mountains; our army fought hard, defeated them, took their hill, and Dingguo's troops then fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ma La drove his officers and men to fight hard. After Dingguo's troops had fallen back, more than four thousand men charged down from the hills. The Qing army fought them off, took the heights, and Dingguo's force fled.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，定國走高州，珠瑪喇遣梅勒額真畢力克圖、鄂拜等以師從之，戰於興業，再戰於橫州，定國渡江焚其橋，我師躡其後，三戰皆勝。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twelfth year Dingguo fled to Gaozhou; Zhu Ma La sent meile ejen Biliktui, Ebai, and others with troops in pursuit; they fought at Xingye and again at Hengzhou; Dingguo crossed the river and burned the bridge; our army followed close behind; all three battles were won.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twelfth year Dingguo fled to Gaozhou. Zhu Ma La sent meile ejen Biliktui, Ebai, and others in pursuit. They fought at Xingye and again at Hengzhou. Dingguo crossed the river and burned the bridge, but the Qing army pressed close behind and won all three battles.

sentences.zh: 定國走入安隆，珠瑪喇與尚可喜等復高州、雷州、廉州三府及所屬州三、縣八；

translations.literal: Dingguo fled into Anlong; Zhu Ma La with Shang Kexi and others recovered the three prefectures of Gaozhou, Leizhou, and Lianzhou along with three subordinate prefectures and eight counties;
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo fled into Anlong. Zhu Ma La and Shang Kexi recovered the three prefectures of Gaozhou, Leizhou, and Lianzhou along with three subordinate prefectures and eight counties;

sentences.zh: 又克廣西境州二、縣四：凡二十二城。

translations.literal: and also took two prefectures and four counties within Guangxi—twenty-two cities in all.
translations.idiomatic: They also took two prefectures and four counties within Guangxi—twenty-two cities in all.

sentences.zh: 得像十六、馬二百有奇，他器械稱是。

translations.literal: They obtained sixteen elephants, over two hundred horses, and comparable quantities of other weapons and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: They captured sixteen elephants, more than two hundred horses, and comparable quantities of other arms and equipment.

sentences.zh: 上賜敕獎勵。

translations.literal: The emperor granted an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict commending him.

sentences.zh: 九月，師還，入見，上諭大學士馮銓等曰：「珠瑪喇率師徵廣東捷歸，年方五十。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army returned; on audience the emperor told Grand Secretaries Feng Quan and others: "Zhu Ma La has returned victorious from leading troops on the Guangdong expedition; he is only fifty years old.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army returned. On audience the emperor told Grand Secretaries Feng Quan and others: "Zhu Ma La has returned victorious from the Guangdong campaign, and he is only fifty.

sentences.zh: 壯年能立功，為有福也！」

translations.literal: To win merit in the prime of life is indeed fortune!"
translations.idiomatic: To win such merit in the prime of life is good fortune indeed!"

sentences.zh: 賜茶慰勞。

translations.literal: Tea was granted to console and reward him.
translations.idiomatic: Tea was granted to console and reward him.

sentences.zh: 部議進一等阿思哈尼哈番兼一拖沙喇哈番，上以珠瑪喇等擊破定國，雪衡州、桂林之憤，功高不當循常格，命再議，進三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: The Board proposed advancing him to first-class asihnihan hafan with an additional tuosalaha hafan; the emperor said that Zhu Ma La and the others in breaking Dingguo had avenged the humiliations of Hengzhou and Guilin, that the merit was too great to follow ordinary rules, and ordered reconsideration; he was advanced to third-class jingqi nihafan.
translations.idiomatic: The Board proposed promoting him to first-class asihnihan hafan with an additional tuosalaha hafan. The emperor said Zhu Ma La and the others, in breaking Dingguo, had avenged the humiliations at Hengzhou and Guilin and that such merit should not be judged by ordinary rules. He ordered reconsideration, and Zhu Ma La was promoted to third-class jingqi nihafan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，卒，諡襄敏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi he died and was granted the posthumous title Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 he died and was posthumously titled Xiangmin.

sentences.zh: 瓦爾喀珠瑪喇，那木都魯氏，居瓦爾​​喀部渾春地。

translations.literal: Walgari Zhu Ma La—Walgari Zhu Ma La, of the Namdulu clan, dwelt at Hunchun in the Walgari tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Walgari Zhu Ma La was of the Namdulu clan and lived at Hunchun in the Walgari tribe.

sentences.zh: 祖察禮，率族歸太祖。

translations.literal: His grandfather Chali led the clan to submit to Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Chali led the clan to submit to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲正白旗。

translations.literal: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner system was established he was assigned to the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 珠瑪喇方少時，即從太祖征伐，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: While Zhu Ma La was still young he followed Taizu on campaigns and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: While still young, Zhu Ma La followed Taizu on campaign and was appointed niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 以同時有碧魯珠瑪喇，命綴地於名以為別。

translations.literal: Because there was at the same time a Bilu Zhu Ma La, he was ordered to append his place to his name for distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Because another Zhu Ma La of the Bilu clan existed at the same time, he was ordered to append his place-name to his name for distinction.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 嘗率噶布什賢兵十人，逐得蒙古亡者四十三人，上特予優賚。

translations.literal: Once he led ten Gabsihiyan soldiers and hunted down forty-three fugitive Mongols; the emperor specially granted him generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Once he led ten Gabsihiyan soldiers and hunted down forty-three fugitive Mongols; the emperor specially rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，與牛錄額真喀凱等分道伐瓦爾喀部，徇額勒約索、額黑庫倫、僧庫勒諸路，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, together with niru ejen Kakai and others, he took separate routes to campaign against the Walgari tribes, sweeping through Ele'yuosuo, Eheikulun, Sengkule, and other routes, and captured a great many people and goods.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he and niru ejen Kakai and others took separate routes against the Walgari tribes, sweeping Ele'yuosuo, Eheikulun, Sengkule, and other routes and capturing a great many people and goods.

sentences.zh: 以功加半個前程。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he received half a rank of advancement.

sentences.zh: 三年，授吏部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed executive officer of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made executive officer of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，從貝勒岳託伐明，攻故城，夜以雲梯登，克之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year he followed Prince Yoto in a campaign against Ming, attacked Gucheng, scaled the wall by night with cloud ladders, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year he followed Prince Yoto against Ming, attacked Gucheng, scaled the wall by night with cloud ladders, and took it.

sentences.zh: 明總兵侯世祿師赴援，珠瑪喇徒步突敵軍，力戰，世祿敗去；
