translations.literal: Ming regional commander Hou Shilu's army came to relieve the city; Zhu Ma La on foot charged into the enemy host and fought fiercely; Shilu was defeated and withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: When Ming regional commander Hou Shilu's army came to relieve the city, Zhu Ma La on foot charged the enemy and fought hard; Shilu was defeated and withdrew;

sentences.zh: 珠瑪喇創甚，明太監高起潛師復至，負創戰尤力，起潛亦敗去。

translations.literal: Zhu Ma La was grievously wounded; the eunuch Gao Qiqian's army then arrived; fighting despite his wounds with special vigor, he also defeated Qiqian, who withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ma La was badly wounded. When the eunuch Gao Qiqian's army arrived, he fought on despite his wounds with even greater force and drove Qiqian off as well.

sentences.zh: 十月，從略錦州，敗明兵，入邊至太平寨，明兵嚴陣以待，珠瑪喇徒步大呼，入陣斫鹿角，中創不稍卻，明兵大潰。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he joined in raiding Jinzhou, defeated Ming troops, entered the border as far as Taiping Stockade; Ming troops waited in strict formation; Zhu Ma La on foot shouted loudly, entered the ranks and hacked at the abatis, was wounded but did not retreat in the least; the Ming army broke in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined the raid on Jinzhou, defeated Ming troops, and entered the border as far as Taiping Stockade. Ming forces waited in tight formation. Zhu Ma La on foot shouted, entered the ranks, and hacked at the abatis. Wounded, he did not give ground, and the Ming army broke in disorder.

sentences.zh: 十一月，從承政索海、薩穆什喀伐索倫部，珠瑪喇俘十有九人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he followed chief minister Suohai and Samuska in a campaign against the Solon tribes; Zhu Ma La captured nineteen men.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he followed chief minister Suohai and Samuska against the Solon tribes; Zhu Ma La captured nineteen men.

sentences.zh: 道攻虎爾哈部雅克薩，焚其郛，牛錄額真和託先登，珠瑪喇繼之，克其城。

translations.literal: En route they attacked Yaksa of the Hurka tribes, burned its outer wall; niru ejen Hoto was first to scale the wall and Zhu Ma La followed, taking the city.
translations.idiomatic: En route they attacked Yaksa of the Hurka tribes and burned its outer wall. Niru ejen Hoto was first over the wall and Zhu Ma La followed; the city fell.

sentences.zh: 師還，次黑龍江之濱，虎爾哈潰兵復合，烏魯甦屯酋博穆博果爾以六千人擊正藍旗後隊，珠瑪喇與索海設伏掩擊，殲敵略盡。

translations.literal: When the army returned it halted on the banks of the Amur; Hurka scattered troops regrouped; the chieftain of Ulusu settlement Bombogor with six thousand men struck the rear of the Plain Blue Banner; Zhu Ma La and Suohai laid an ambush and struck from concealment, destroying the enemy almost to the last man.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march the army halted on the Amur. Hurka scattered troops regrouped, and the chieftain of Ulusu, Bombogor, struck the Plain Blue Banner rear with six thousand men. Zhu Ma La and Suohai laid an ambush and nearly wiped out the enemy.

sentences.zh: 以功進三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to third-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was promoted to third-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍錦州，擊敗松山騎卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined a campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou, defeating Songshan cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against Ming, besieged Jinzhou, and defeated Songshan cavalry.

sentences.zh: 明總督洪承疇赴援，營松山西北，我師與戰，右翼敗；

translations.literal: Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou came to relieve the city and encamped northwest of Songshan; our army fought them and the right wing was defeated;
translations.idiomatic: Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou came to relieve the city and encamped northwest of Songshan. The Qing army fought them and the right wing was defeated;

sentences.zh: 敵萃於左翼，珠瑪喇力戰，砲傷頷，踣且絕，上深悼之，賜襚以斂。

translations.literal: the enemy massed on the left wing; Zhu Ma La fought fiercely; a cannon ball wounded his jaw; he fell and almost died; the emperor deeply mourned him and granted grave goods for his burial.
translations.idiomatic: the enemy massed on the left wing. Zhu Ma La fought hard, was wounded in the jaw by cannon fire, and fell nearly dead. The emperor deeply mourned him and granted grave goods for his burial.

sentences.zh: 後三日復蘇，上聞喜甚，令加意休養，毋即從軍，命監造盛京塔，塔成，厚賚之。

translations.literal: Three days later he revived; when the emperor heard he was greatly pleased, ordered him to rest and recuperate carefully and not return to the army immediately, and had him supervise construction of the pagoda at Shengjing; when it was completed, he rewarded him generously.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later he revived. The emperor was greatly pleased, ordered him to rest and not return to the army immediately, and had him supervise construction of the pagoda at Shengjing. When it was completed, he rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 旋令率師戍錦州，明兵來攻，戰竟夜，敵敗去，斬四十餘級，得云梯及軍械。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead troops to garrison Jinzhou; Ming troops came to attack; they fought all night; the enemy was defeated and withdrew; over forty heads were taken along with scaling ladders and military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to garrison Jinzhou with his troops. Ming forces attacked and they fought all night. The enemy was defeated, more than forty heads were taken, and scaling ladders and arms were captured.

sentences.zh: 累進一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly advanced to first-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to first-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成，平馬山口土寇，以功加半個前程。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed in the entry through the passes, attacked Li Zicheng, and pacified bandits at Mashankou; for merit he was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shunzhi he entered the passes, attacked Li Zicheng, and pacified bandits at Mashankou. For his achievements he received half a rank of advancement.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，調戶部理事官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year he was transferred to executive officer of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year he was transferred to executive officer of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一月，與固山額真巴顏等帥師會定西大將軍何洛會西討張獻忠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, together with gushan ejen Bayan and others, he led troops to join Pacification General of the West He Luohui in a western campaign against Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he led troops with gushan ejen Bayan and others to join Pacification General of the West He Luohui in the western campaign against Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 三年，肅親王豪格代何洛會督諸軍向階州，聞獻忠兵屯​​禮縣南，遣珠瑪喇分兵擊之，獻忠兵驚竄；

translations.literal: In the third year Prince Hooge of Su replaced He Luohui in commanding the armies toward Jiezhou; hearing that Xianzhong's troops were encamped south of Li County, he dispatched Zhu Ma La with a detached force to strike them; Xianzhong's troops fled in panic;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Prince Hooge of Su replaced He Luohui in commanding the armies toward Jiezhou. Hearing that Xianzhong's troops were encamped south of Li County, he sent Zhu Ma La with a detached force against them, and Xianzhong's troops fled in panic;

sentences.zh: 復與巴牙喇纛章京鰲拜進兵西充，獻忠死，乃還師。

translations.literal: Again with bayara da janggin Oboi he advanced on Xichong; Xianzhong died, and they then returned with the army.
translations.idiomatic: With bayara da janggin Oboi he advanced on Xichong. Xianzhong died, and the army then returned.

sentences.zh: 六年，從討叛將薑瓖，次左衛。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined in suppressing the rebel general Jiang Xiang and halted at Zuowei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the suppression of the rebel general Jiang Xiang and halted at Zuowei.

sentences.zh: 瓖兵屯城外迎戰，珠瑪喇擊之走，城遂下。

translations.literal: Xiang's troops encamped outside the city to meet battle; Zhu Ma La struck them and drove them off, and the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang's troops encamped outside the city to give battle. Zhu Ma La attacked and drove them off, and the city then fell.

sentences.zh: 逐賊寧武關，瓖兵置砲山岡以拒，珠瑪喇與甲喇額真烏庫禮疾馳據岡脊，破其壘，瓖所置總兵劉偉以關降。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels to Ningwu Pass, Xiang's troops placed cannon on a hill to resist; Zhu Ma La and jiala ejen Ukuri galloped swiftly to seize the ridge, broke their fortifications, and Liu Wei, the regional commander Xiang had posted there, surrendered the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rebels to Ningwu Pass, Xiang's troops placed cannon on a hill to block the way. Zhu Ma La and jiala ejen Ukuri galloped to seize the ridge, broke their fortifications, and Liu Wei, the regional commander Xiang had posted there, surrendered the pass.

sentences.zh: 師還，擢正白旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was promoted to meile ejen of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was promoted to meile ejen of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 世職累進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to first-class asihnihan hafan.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank was repeatedly promoted to first-class asihnihan hafan.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，卒，祀四川名宦。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year he died and was enshrined among the notable officials of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the tenth year he died and was enshrined among the notable officials of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 伊瑪喇，其弟也。

translations.literal: Yimala was his younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Yimala was his younger brother.

sentences.zh: 肅親王定四川，伊瑪喇以巴牙喇侍衛從。

translations.literal: When Prince Hooge of Su pacified Sichuan, Yimala followed as a bayara bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Hooge of Su pacified Sichuan, Yimala followed as a bayara bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 師次保寧，獻忠將趙雲桂來攻。

translations.literal: When the army halted at Baoning, Xianzhong's general Zhao Yungui came to attack.
translations.idiomatic: When the army halted at Baoning, Xianzhong's general Zhao Yungui came to attack.

sentences.zh: 伊瑪喇登城射中云桂目，賊駭走，師從之，大捷，即襲其兄世職，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Yimala mounted the wall and shot Yunui in the eye; the bandits fled in terror; the army pursued them to a great victory; he immediately inherited his elder brother's hereditary office and was appointed jiala ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Yimala mounted the wall and shot Yungui in the eye. The rebels fled in terror, the army pursued them to a great victory, and he immediately inherited his elder brother's hereditary rank and was appointed jiala ejen.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，從揚威將軍阿密達討叛將王輔臣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi he followed General for Displaying Might Amida in suppressing the rebel general Wang Fuchen.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13 he followed General for Displaying Might Amida against the rebel general Wang Fuchen.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月，克寧州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year he took Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year he captured Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，進攻平涼，未至八里，輔臣率萬餘人出拒，伊瑪喇從貝勒洞鄂與戰，輔臣敗入城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he advanced to attack Pingliang; eight li short of the city Fuchen led over ten thousand men out to resist; Yimala followed Prince Tongio in battle; Fuchen was defeated and withdrew into the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he advanced on Pingliang. Eight li from the city, Fuchen led more than ten thousand men out to resist. Yimala fought with Prince Tongio, and Fuchen was defeated and withdrew into the city.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從撫遠大將軍圖海復攻平涼，至城北虎山墩诇賊，賊合步騎猝至，伊瑪喇奮戰，賊敗去。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he followed Grand General for Pacifying the Distance Tuhai in again attacking Pingliang; reaching Hushandun north of the city to reconnoiter the rebels, rebel infantry and cavalry combined and suddenly arrived; Yimala fought fiercely and the rebels were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he followed Grand General for Pacifying the Distance Tuhai in the renewed attack on Pingliang. Reaching Hushandun north of the city to reconnoiter the rebels, he was suddenly attacked by combined rebel infantry and cavalry. Yimala fought hard and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 事平，師還。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled the army returned.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，乞休。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 三十四年五月，卒，亦祀四川名宦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirty-fourth year he died and was also enshrined among the notable officials of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirty-fourth year he died and was also enshrined among the notable officials of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，命錄戰功未受賞者，加伊瑪喇拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When Yongzheng ascended the throne, he ordered that those with unrewarded battlefield merits be recorded, and Yimala was granted tuosalaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongzheng ascended the throne, he ordered that unrewarded battlefield merits be recorded, and Yimala was granted tuosalaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 論曰：太宗與明戰，下大凌河，克錦州，皆以全力爭。

translations.literal: Commentary: In Taizong's wars with Ming, taking Greater Linghe and capturing Jinzhou—all were contested with full force.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say that in Taizong's wars with Ming, the captures of Greater Linghe and Jinzhou were each fought with the empire's full strength.

sentences.zh: 壬午之師，間道深入數千里，如行無人之境，為前此所未有，則圖爾格之績也。

translations.literal: The Renwu campaign, penetrating thousands of li by hidden routes as if traversing uninhabited country—unprecedented before then—was Tu Erge's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The Renwu campaign, penetrating thousands of li by hidden routes as if through empty country—unprecedented until then—was Tu Erge's achievement.

sentences.zh: 以是戰多踵為功宗。

translations.literal: Many later achievements took this campaign as their model.
translations.idiomatic: Many later feats took this campaign as the standard of merit.

sentences.zh: 伊爾登、巴奇蘭、齊爾格申輩皆驍武，從太宗征伐，搴旗陷陣；

translations.literal: Yierdeng, Baqilan, Qi Ergeshen, and their like were all dashing warriors who followed Taizong on campaigns, seizing banners and charging the ranks;
translations.idiomatic: Yierdeng, Baqilan, Qi Ergeshen, and their like were all fierce warriors who followed Taizong on campaign, seizing banners and charging the ranks;

sentences.zh: 而葉臣、珠瑪喇入關後，又以夙將力戰策勳。

translations.literal: while Ye Chen and Zhu Ma La, after entering the passes, again won merit as veteran generals fighting fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: while Ye Chen and Zhu Ma La, after entering the passes, again earned merit as veteran generals fighting hard.

sentences.zh: 大業將成，群才翊運，盛矣！

translations.literal: The great enterprise was nearing completion; many talents aided the fortune—how magnificent!
translations.idiomatic: The great enterprise was nearing completion; many talents aided the dynasty's fortune—how magnificent!
